1|# Implementation Plan — Separate KainBain Docs Repo per Project
2|
3|Task: `7f6220c3-c536-489c-b952-9858aae9ef21`
4|Status: planning (no code changed in this stage)
5|Companion survey: `./SURVEY.md` (7 questions, currently **unanswered** — see §2)
6|
7|## 1. Goal and non-goals
8|
9|**Goal.** Let a project store its KainBain-specific information in a *separate,
10|private* git repo ("docs repo") instead of inside the main project repo, so that:
11|
12|- large projects are not bloated by `docs/tasks/*` history;
13|- teams with non-KainBain users (or public repos) see no KainBain traces;
14|- a solo user can "stealth use" KainBain at work on a shared repo;
15|- runners check out the docs repo adjacent to the main repo with synced task
16|  branches, keeping operations as close to normal as possible;
17|- the option is offered in UI configuration at project import/create time
18|  (especially on import).
19|
20|**Explicit non-goals for v1** (to be confirmed against survey answers):
21|
22|- Multi-project sharing of one docs repo (survey q7) — v1 is one docs repo per
23|  project; sharing is designed-for but not built.
24|- Automatic migration of existing docs into the new repo (survey q4) — v1
25|  offers "leave old docs, new work goes to the separate repo" plus a documented
26|  manual move; auto-move is a follow-up.
27|- Hiding `kb/<taskId>` working branches from the shared main repo (survey q6)
28|  — v1 keeps code branches in the main repo and separates only docs/state (the
29|  simplest reading of the task); full branch stealth is a named follow-up with
30|  its own design section (§7).
31|
32|## 2. Survey analysis (SURVEY.md) — unanswered, with recommendations
33|
34|The grill survey exists but `answers` is `{}` — nobody has answered yet. The
35|plan below assumes the **recommended** answer for each question (marked ★) and
36|notes where the code must keep the other option open. Before implementation
37|starts, re-run the grill (or get 5 minutes of the requester's time) to confirm;
38|each recommendation is one line to flip.
39|
40|| # | Question | Recommended answer ★ | Why / plan impact |
41||---|----------|----------------------|-------------------|
42|| q1 | What lives in the docs repo? | ★ **Everything KainBain**: task docs (`docs/tasks/*`), plans, reports, **and** KainBain settings/state (`.kainbain/` contents: `project.json`, sessions, worktrees, quarantine) | Stealth requires zero KainBain traces in the main repo (q5). Splitting settings from docs would leave a decision matrix in every resolver. One "KainBain home" location keeps `resolveDocsPath`/`resolveKainbainDir` a single-branch change. If q1 instead resolves to "task docs only", Phase 3 still works: `project.json` stays in main repo and only the docs resolvers move — the seam is the same. |
43|| q2 | Where in the import/create UI? | ★ **Tucked under an 'Advanced' section** on *both* create and import dialogs | Task text says "as an advance option" and "allowed from the default when you import/create". Advanced-collapsed keeps the simple form simple (existing dialogs are minimal: name+remote, path+name) while satisfying "from the default". Also add the same fields to Project Settings (Paths & Repositories) so it can be enabled later. |
44|| q3 | Auth for the (private) docs repo? | ★ **Separate login details just for the docs repo** (stored credential, optional: fall back to same-as-main when blank) | Main repo may be public/shared with no credential while docs repo is private, or the two live on different hosts. Design a `docsRepo` credential slot reusing the existing credential-redaction + `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` patterns; empty = "same as main repo" keeps the simple case one field. Research spike R1 (Phase 0) must confirm the current credential flow first. |
45|| q4 | Existing docs when switching on? | ★ **Leave old docs; only new work goes to the separate repo** (+ documented manual move command) | Auto-move is a data-loss-risky migration (symlink/shadow history — see `ensureDocsLink` incident note). Leave-in-place is safe, reversible, and matches "make change easy then make the change". Auto-move becomes a follow-up stage with its own backup/verify semantics. |
46|| q5 | Main repo completely free of traces? | ★ **Yes — nothing KainBain-related in the main repo** | This is the stated stealth goal ("so I can stealth use kainbain at work"). Consequences: no `.kainbain/` dir, no `docs/tasks/` content, no pointer file, and (v1) `.gitignore` entries must also not be written into the main repo — they move into the docs repo / global config. The task text's "tiny pointer file is fine" alternative is explicitly rejected for v1 because any committed file defeats stealth. |
47|| q6 | Keep `kb/*` working branches out of shared repo too? | ★ **No — branches in the main repo are fine for v1; only docs/state move** (with a designed follow-up) | True branch stealth (code work happening in a fork/private mirror + PRs back) is a fundamentally different execution model (merge/push/review paths all assume `kb/<task>` exists on origin). V1 separates docs; §7 sketches the branch-stealth follow-up. If the requester insists on full stealth for v1, the plan gains ~2 extra phases — escalate before starting. |
48|| q7 | One docs repo per project, or shared? | ★ **One docs repo per project only (v1)** | Sharing needs namespacing (`<docsRepo>/<projectSlug>/tasks/...`), cross-project locking, and quota/permission questions. Single-project keeps every resolver a pure path swap. Design the on-disk layout with a namespaced root anyway (`tasks/` at top level today, reservable for `<slug>/` prefix later) so sharing is additive. |

54|## 3. Current-state findings (grounded in the repo)
55|
56|All paths below are relative to the repo root. This is the surface the plan
57|must move:

60|
61|- `api/projectStore.js` — `ProjectStore`: filesystem-backed projects. Key
62|  fields on the project record: `cwd` (main checkout), `notesPath`/`notesDir`,
63|  `docsDirName` (default `docs`), `centralizedDocs` (default true),
64|  `kainbainDirName` (default `.kainbain`), `gitUrl`/`repoUrl`, `useBranches`.

67|- `api/docsPath.js` — **the docs seam**: `resolveDocsDirName`,
68|  `isCentralizedDocsEnabled`, `normalizeDocsSettings`,
69|  `assertValidDocsDirNameForWrite`, `resolveDocsPath(cwd, project)`,
70|  `resolveTasksDir`, `resolveTaskDocsDir`, `docsProjectFor`,
71|  `reportRelPath`, `docsTasksIgnorePath`. Every task-docs path flows through

73|- `api/kainbainDir.js` — **the state seam**: mirrors `docsPath.js` for
74|  `<cwd>/.kainbain/` (`resolveKainbainDir`, `resolveProjectConfigPath`,

76|  `kainbainIgnorePath`). Per q1-recommended, both seams move together.

94|### 3.2 Runner — adjacent checkout and synced branches
95|
96|- `runner/project.js` — `prepareWorkdir({ repoUrl, localPath, workRoot,
97|  taskId })`: clone-mode mirror at `<workRoot>/mirrors/<slug>` (+
98|  `refreshMirror`) or adopt-mode local path; per-task worktree

100|  `refreshWorktreeToRemote`, LRU eviction under `WORKTREE_CAP`,

115|### 3.3 Frontend — create/import/settings
116|
117|- `frontend/src/components/layout/Header.jsx` — New Project modal (name + git
118|  remote) and Add Existing Project modal (path + display name + KainBain
119|  folder). No "Advanced" disclosure exists yet — one must be added (q2).
120|- `frontend/src/components/settings/PathsAndReposSection.jsx` (+
121|  `ProjectSettingsForm.jsx`) — Files & Repositories block: cwd, notes symlink,

126|### 3.4 Key invariants to preserve
127|
128|1. **Single-branch resolvers**: `resolveDocsPath` / `resolveKainbainDir` stay
129|   the only place that maps (project, cwd) → absolute path. No caller
130|   hand-builds `cwd + "/docs"`.
131|2. **Redacted-at-rest URLs**: stored repo URLs are redacted; live git reads
132|   `.git/config` (see `detectGitRemote`, `redactCredentials`).
133|3. **Never-lose-work git hygiene**: recovery branches, no force-delete of
134|   unpushed work, `WORKTREE_CAP` eviction rules — the docs worktree inherits
135|   all of it.
136|4. **Runner ships standalone**: runner-side helpers cannot import backend code
137|   (the `resolveRunnerDocsDirName` duplication is intentional).
138|5. **Tolerant reads, strict writes**: resolvers degrade to defaults on garbage;
139|   write paths 400 with `INVALID_*` codes (see `assertValidDocsDirNameForWrite`
140|   pattern).

142|## 4. Target design (v1)
143|
144|### 4.1 Data model — new project fields
145|
146|```text
147|project.docsRepo: {
148|  url: string|null        # credential-REDACTED remote URL, e.g. "https://git.example.com/me/proj-kb.git"
149|  localPath: string|null  # backend-side checkout of the docs repo (absolute).
150|                          # For adopted/local setups: a path the operator gives or
151|                          # KainBain provisions next to cwd. For remote-backed: the
152|                          # backend's own clone/mirror location.
153|  branchMode: "synced"    # v1 fixed: docs repo carries the same kb/<taskId>
154|                          # branches as the code repo (see §4.3). Reserved for
155|                          # future "single-branch" mode.
156|  # auth: decided by research spike R1. Preferred: reuse the host's existing
157|  # credential mechanism per-remote (git credential helper / env), with an
158|  # optional per-project docs credential slot when R1 shows a gap.
159|}
160|```
161|
162|- Absent `docsRepo` (legacy projects, default) = today's behaviour, byte for
163|  byte. This is the compatibility anchor: every new branch is `if
164|  (hasDocsRepo(project)) … else …today…`.
165|- Validation mirrors `assertValidDocsDirNameForWrite`:
166|  `assertValidDocsRepoForWrite` → 400 `INVALID_DOCS_REPO_*` codes; tolerant
167|  `normalizeDocsRepoSettings` for reads.
168|- One docs repo per project enforced (q7): backend refuses a `localPath`/`url`
169|  already claimed by another project (clear 409 message), until sharing is
170|  designed.
171|
172|### 4.2 Backend layout — "KainBain home" split
173|
174|Introduce one concept: **`kainbainHome/projectCwd` split**.
175|
176|- Today: `projectCwd` serves as *both* code home and KainBain home
177|  (`<cwd>/docs/tasks`, `<cwd>/.kainbain/*`).
178|- With `docsRepo`: code home stays `projectCwd`; KainBain home becomes the
179|  docs-repo checkout (`docsRepo.localPath` on the backend).
180|- Implementation: add `resolveKainbainHome(project, projectCwd)` =
181|  `docsRepo.localPath || projectCwd`, then re-point `resolveDocsPath` and
182|  `resolveKainbainDir` at it (they already take `(cwd, project)` — the
183|  signature barely changes; internally `cwd` becomes "kainbain home").
184|  All downstream consumers (`taskDocsFiles`, `taskWorkspace`,
185|  `resolveTaskDocsDir`, `reportRelPath`, …) inherit the move with no edits —
186|  this is the "make change easy" payoff.
187|- `ensureDocsLink` / centralised-docs symlink: when `docsRepo` is set, the
188|  `<cwd>/docs` symlink is **not created** (stealth, q5) and
189|  `centralizedDocs` is ignored for that project (documented precedence:
190|  `docsRepo` > `centralizedDocs:false` > symlink). The docs checkout itself is
191|  a real git repo, not a symlink.
192|- `.gitignore` management: today KainBain writes ignore entries for
193|  `docs/tasks/` + `.kainbain/` into the main repo. With `docsRepo`, nothing is
194|  written into the main repo (q5 ★); equivalent ignores (if still needed) live
195|  in the docs repo. Audit every ignore-writing call site in Phase 1.
196|- `project.json`: per q1 ★, the authoritative copy lives in the docs repo
197|  (`<docsHome>/.kainbain/project.json`… or flattened — decided in Phase 1;
198|  recommend keeping the `.kainbain/` layout identical so resolvers don't fork).
199|  The backend's project *registry* (`projectRegistry.js`) keeps a pointer so
200|  `scanProjects` still finds the project. Main repo keeps zero files.
201|
202|### 4.3 Branching — synced task branches across two repos

The instance the human checks (`http://192.168.1.206:3100`, build

this branch: (1) the deployed build predates the merged feature entirely
in the visibility-relevant surfaces, and (2) even on `main`, the Create/
Adopt Advanced sections are collapsed and generically named, so a reviewer

Read text file `docs/tasks/7f6220c3-c536-489c-b952-9858aae9ef21/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`.
1|# Implementation Plan — Separate KainBain Docs Repo per Project
2|
3|Task: `7f6220c3-c536-489c-b952-9858aae9ef21`
4|Status: planning (no code changed in this stage)
5|Companion survey: `./SURVEY.md` (7 questions, currently **unanswered** — see §2)
6|
7|## 1. Goal and non-goals
8|
9|**Goal.** Let a project store its KainBain-specific information in a *separate,
10|private* git repo ("docs repo") instead of inside the main project repo, so that:
11|
12|- large projects are not bloated by `docs/tasks/*` history;
13|- teams with non-KainBain users (or public repos) see no KainBain traces;
14|- a solo user can "stealth use" KainBain at work on a shared repo;
15|- runners check out the docs repo adjacent to the main repo with synced task
16|  branches, keeping operations as close to normal as possible;
17|- the option is offered in UI configuration at project import/create time
18|  (especially on import).
19|
20|**Explicit non-goals for v1** (to be confirmed against survey answers):
21|
22|- Multi-project sharing of one docs repo (survey q7) — v1 is one docs repo per
23|  project; sharing is designed-for but not built.
24|- Automatic migration of existing docs into the new repo (survey q4) — v1
25|  offers "leave old docs, new work goes to the separate repo" plus a documented
26|  manual move; auto-move is a follow-up.
27|- Hiding `kb/<taskId>` working branches from the shared main repo (survey q6)
28|  — v1 keeps code branches in the main repo and separates only docs/state (the
29|  simplest reading of the task); full branch stealth is a named follow-up with
30|  its own design section (§7).

142|## 4. Target design (v1)
143|
144|### 4.1 Data model — new project fields
145|
146|```text
147|project.docsRepo: {
148|  url: string|null        # credential-REDACTED remote URL, e.g. "https://git.example.com/me/proj-kb.git"
149|  localPath: string|null  # backend-side checkout of the docs repo (absolute).
150|                          # For adopted/local setups: a path the operator gives or
151|                          # KainBain provisions next to cwd. For remote-backed: the
152|                          # backend's own clone/mirror location.
153|  branchMode: "synced"    # v1 fixed: docs repo carries the same kb/<taskId>
154|                          # branches as the code repo (see §4.3). Reserved for
155|                          # future "single-branch" mode.
156|  # auth: decided by research spike R1. Preferred: reuse the host's existing
157|  # credential mechanism per-remote (git credential helper / env), with an
158|  # optional per-project docs credential slot when R1 shows a gap.
159|}
160|```
161|
162|- Absent `docsRepo` (legacy projects, default) = today's behaviour, byte for
163|  byte. This is the compatibility anchor: every new branch is `if
164|  (hasDocsRepo(project)) … else …today…`.
165|- Validation mirrors `assertValidDocsDirNameForWrite`:
166|  `assertValidDocsRepoForWrite` → 400 `INVALID_DOCS_REPO_*` codes; tolerant
167|  `normalizeDocsRepoSettings` for reads.
168|- One docs repo per project enforced (q7): backend refuses a `localPath`/`url`
169|  already claimed by another project (clear 409 message), until sharing is
170|  designed.
171|
172|### 4.2 Backend layout — "KainBain home" split
173|
174|Introduce one concept: **`kainbainHome/projectCwd` split**.
175|
176|- Today: `projectCwd` serves as *both* code home and KainBain home
177|  (`<cwd>/docs/tasks`, `<cwd>/.kainbain/*`).
178|- With `docsRepo`: code home stays `projectCwd`; KainBain home becomes the
179|  docs-repo checkout (`docsRepo.localPath` on the backend).
180|- Implementation: add `resolveKainbainHome(project, projectCwd)` =
181|  `docsRepo.localPath || projectCwd`, then re-point `resolveDocsPath` and
182|  `resolveKainbainDir` at it (they already take `(cwd, project)` — the
183|  signature barely changes; internally `cwd` becomes "kainbain home").
184|  All downstream consumers (`taskDocsFiles`, `taskWorkspace`,
185|  `resolveTaskDocsDir`, `reportRelPath`, …) inherit the move with no edits —
186|  this is the "make change easy" payoff.
187|- `ensureDocsLink` / centralised-docs symlink: when `docsRepo` is set, the
188|  `<cwd>/docs` symlink is **not created** (stealth, q5) and
189|  `centralizedDocs` is ignored for that project (documented precedence:
190|  `docsRepo` > `centralizedDocs:false` > symlink). The docs checkout itself is
191|  a real git repo, not a symlink.
192|- `.gitignore` management: today KainBain writes ignore entries for
193|  `docs/tasks/` + `.kainbain/` into the main repo. With `docsRepo`, nothing is
194|  written into the main repo (q5 ★); equivalent ignores (if still needed) live
195|  in the docs repo. Audit every ignore-writing call site in Phase 1.
196|- `project.json`: per q1 ★, the authoritative copy lives in the docs repo
197|  (`<docsHome>/.kainbain/project.json`… or flattened — decided in Phase 1;
198|  recommend keeping the `.kainbain/` layout identical so resolvers don't fork).
199|  The backend's project *registry* (`projectRegistry.js`) keeps a pointer so
200|  `scanProjects` still finds the project. Main repo keeps zero files.
201|
202|### 4.3 Branching — synced task branches across two repos
203|
204|- The docs repo carries the **same branch names** as the code repo:
205|  `kb/<taskId>` per task, same default branch. "Synced" means: created from
206|  the same base event, checked out/created together at stage pickup
207|  (`ensureTaskBranch` gains a docs-repo twin), and pushed together at handoff.
208|- Merge/review semantics stay code-repo-driven: the Merge stage merges code;
209|  docs branches merge (or fast-forward) alongside so docs history tracks task
210|  history. Exact merge coupling (same commit message? docs-merge part of the
211|  merge stage, or lazy?) is decided in design task D3 (Phase 1) — v1 default:
212|  docs branch is merged/fast-forwarded by the same stage right after the code
213|  merge, failures reported but never blocking the code merge verdict… or
214|  blocking — D3 decides with a written rationale.
215|- Runner workdir layout becomes a pair:
216|  `<workRoot>/kb-<taskId>` (code worktree, as today) +
217|  `<workRoot>/kb-<taskId>-docs` (docs worktree, same branch name), each with
218|  its own mirror (`mirrors/<code-slug>`, `mirrors/<docs-slug>`).
219|  `prepareWorkdir` grows a `docsRepoUrl` option; eviction/recovery/reap logic
220|  treats the pair atomically (evict/reap both, park both).
221|- `syncTaskDocs` becomes a no-op source change: with docsRepo, task docs live
222|  *in* the docs worktree already — the copy step is skipped and
223|  `KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS` points at the docs worktree path. `collectTaskFiles`
224|  reads from the docs worktree. `commitAndPush` commits+pushes **both**
225|  worktrees (docs first or code first — D3 decides; recommend docs-first so a
226|  half-pushed state never shows code without its docs… or code-first — D3
227|  writes the rationale either way).
228|

230|
231|- Backend git ops and runner `runGit` both rely on ambient credentials today
232|  (live `.git/config` remotes + `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` fail-fast). The docs
233|  remote must authenticate the same way wherever possible (same host ⇒ same
234|  credential helper ⇒ zero new secrets UI).
235|- If R1 finds runners/hosts where ambient auth can't cover a second remote,
236|  add an optional per-project docs credential stored server-side, injected via

380|- **U3. Visibility of state**: project settings shows docs-repo sync state
381|  (last sync, ahead/behind, branch) — minimum: the info the operator needs to
382|  trust the split. Exact widget set in D3/Phase 4 design pass; keep it to one
383|  compact block.
384|- **U4. Frontend tests** for U1/U2 (existing `*.test.jsx` patterns) + a11y
385|  labels on new inputs.
386|
387|Phase 4 exit criteria: frontend suite green; manual walkthrough of
388|create-with-docsRepo, adopt-with-docsRepo, enable-later, disable flows.
389|
390|### Phase 5 — Docs, migration aid, rollout
391|
392|- **Docs**: (a) user guide — when to use a docs repo, create/adopt/enable
393|  walkthroughs, auth setup per R1, the q4 manual-move procedure, stealth
394|  checklist (how to verify the main repo is clean: `git status`, `git log
395|  --all --oneline --grep`, branch list); (b) operator notes — two-repo branch
396|  model, recovery branches in both repos, eviction/cap semantics, troubleshoot
397|  matrix from ADR D3; (c) JSDoc/AGENTS-MAP updates for new modules.
398|- **Migration aid (manual-move procedure)**: a documented, copy-pasteable
399|  sequence (or a small `scripts/` helper — decide in Phase 2; script preferred
400|  if it stays <100 lines, else docs-only) to move existing `docs/tasks/*` +
401|  `.kainbain/*` into a fresh docs repo with verification steps. Auto-move
402|  stays a follow-up.
403|- **Rollout**: feature is purely opt-in (absent `docsRepo` = today's
404|  behaviour); no migration of existing projects; no flag needed beyond the
405|  field itself. Recommend: dogfood on one real project (this repo's own
406|  KainBain usage is the natural candidate) for one full task lifecycle before
407|  announcing.
408|
409|## 6. Assurance plan — proving the change was implemented
410|
411|### 6.1 Testing plan (maps to phases)
412|
413|| Level | What | Where / how | Phase |
414||-------|------|-------------|-------|
415|| Unit — resolvers | `resolveKainbainHome` legacy-default + docs-home branches; `normalizeDocsRepoSettings` tolerance; `assertValidDocsRepoForWrite` strict codes | `api/kainbainHome.test.js` (new), `api/project/docsRepo.test.js` (new), following `docsPath.test.js` patterns | 1 |
416|| Unit — validators | create/update/register accept/reject matrices incl. 409 claim conflicts, redaction of stored URL | `api/routes/projects.docsRepo.test.js` (new, copying `projects.docsSettings.test.js`) | 2 |
417|| Unit — runner seam | `docsWorkdirFor`, `shouldSyncTaskDocs`, pair naming, cap accounting | `runner/project.test.js` extensions | 1, 3 |
418|| Integration — backend git | two throwaway repos: provision, `ensureTaskBranch` twin, sync both, merge both, dirty-tree refusal per repo, disable-refusal when ahead | `api/git.*.integration.test.js` style, isolated test roots (`isolatedTestRoots.js`) | 2 |
419|| Integration — runner | paired prepare/reuse/evict/reap; push both; conflict attribution; remote-runner claim with docs fields | `runner/*.test.js` + a scripted local-remote e2e (docs-only verification counts as e2e here) | 3 |
420|| Cleanliness (the stealth gate) | **Main-repo snapshot test**: tree before/after provisioning + full task run must be identical except code changes — no `.kainbain/`, no `docs/tasks/`, no `.gitignore` edits, no pointer file | Backend test (B2) + runner e2e (Phase 3 exit) | 2, 3 |
421|| Regression | Entire existing suite (`npm run test:unit` + runner tests) passes **unmodified** — legacy path byte-identical | CI / `run-tests.sh` | every phase |
422|| UI | Advanced disclosure behaviour, validation messages, settings enable/disable/banner flows | `*.test.jsx` + headless checks (`npm run capture:screenshot` only if visual state is in doubt) | 4 |
423|| Dogfood | One real project runs a full task lifecycle on a docs repo; operator verifies main remote shows only code branches + code diff | Manual, checklist in docs | 5 |
424|
425|Primary gate overall: `npm run test:unit` (per stage guidance) plus the
426|runner tests and the stealth-gate snapshot tests. No long-lived background
427|servers for verification — isolated headless runners / mock fixtures /
428|throwaway git repos only.
429|
430|### 6.2 Documentation plan
431|
432|1. **ADR (D3, Phase 1)** — the spec: branch-sync coupling, push order, failure
433|   taxonomy, claim-contract changes, cap accounting. Reviewed before Phase 2.
434|2. **Spike notes (Phase 0)** — R1 auth decision, R2 trace checklist, R3 census,
435|   R4 go/no-go. Stored under this task's docs folder.
436|3. **User guide (Phase 5)** — as listed in Phase 5; must include the stealth
437|   verification checklist and the q4 manual-move procedure.
438|4. **Code docs** — JSDoc `MARK:` blocks on all new modules (repo convention),
439|   `AGENTS-MAP.md` / agent guide updates if new concepts need them, CHANGELOG
440|   entry.
441|5. **This plan** — updated if R0 flips any survey answer (each flip names its
442|   affected phase in §2's table).
443|
444|### 6.3 Acceptance criteria (definition of done)
445|
446|- [ ] A new project can be created with a docs repo from the Advanced section;
447|      an existing repo can be imported the same way (U1).
448|- [ ] An existing project can enable/disable docs repo from settings with
449|      clear messaging (U2, B6).
450|- [ ] Task lifecycle (create → stages → merge) works with docs repo: task docs,
451|      plans, reports land only in the docs repo on synced `kb/<taskId>`
452|      branches (B4, C1–C3).
453|- [ ] Main repo contains zero KainBain traces after provisioning + full run —
454|      proven by the snapshot/stealth-gate tests (B2, Phase 3 exit).
455|- [ ] Runners work in clone mode and adopt mode, local and remote (claim
456|      contract), with pair-atomic eviction/recovery (C1–C5).
457|- [ ] Legacy projects (no `docsRepo`) behave exactly as before — full existing
458|      suite green unmodified.
459|- [ ] Auth: docs remote authenticates per R1 decision; credentials never in
460|      logs/docs/`.git/config`/claim payloads (redaction tests).
461|- [ ] User guide + operator notes + ADR + CHANGELOG written (§6.2).
462|- [ ] Dogfood run completed on one real project (Phase 5).
463|

465|
466|1. **Full branch stealth** (q6-full): code work in a private fork/mirror with

481||------|---------------------|--------------------|

486|| Mixed runner fleet (old runner, new claim) mis-handles docs fields | Low / Med | D3/C4 back-compat decision; old runners ignore-or-refuse loudly, never silently drop docs |
487|| Scope creep into full branch stealth (q6) | Med / Med | Survey confirmation R0; §7 follow-up; escalate if v1 scope changes |

1|# PR Review — Separate docs repo per project (task 7f6220c3)
2|
3|Reviewer stage: PR review. Verdict: **PASS** (details at the bottom).
4|Scope of review: full `git diff main` (62 files, +9453/−99), previous stage reports, and live verification runs. No source files were modified in this stage; only this report and three screenshots under this task's docs folder were added.
5|
6|## 1. Does it achieve the goal?
7|
8|Yes. A project can now keep ALL KainBain information (task docs, plans, reports, and the `.kainbain/` state incl. `project.json`) in a separate private git repo:
9|
10|- **Opt-in config surface**: `docsRepo: { url, localPath?, branchMode: "synced" }` on the project record, accepted by `POST /projects`, `POST /projects/register`, and `PATCH /projects/:id` (`api/routes/projects.js`). In the UI it appears under a collapsed **Advanced options** disclosure on both the New Project and Add Existing Project dialogs (`frontend/src/components/layout/Header.jsx` + new `DocsRepoFields.jsx`), and in Project Settings → Files & Repositories (`PathsAndReposSection.jsx`, `ProjectSettingsForm.jsx`) for enable/disable later. Matches survey q2 (Advanced section) and the task text ("allowed from the default when you import/create").
11|- **Stealth (q5)**: with `docsRepo` set, nothing KainBain-related is written into the main repo — `createProject` skips the `.gitignore` write and the docs symlink (`api/projectStore.js:978,1020`), `ensureDocsLink` returns `external-docs` and never touches `<cwd>/docs` (`api/projectStore.js:1523`), `_migrateDocsLink` is skipped (`api/projectStore.js:2082`), and the pointer map (`docs-repo-pointers.json`) lives engine-globally next to the projects registry, never in the main repo (`api/project/docsRepoPointer.js`). Guards: `assertDocsRepoSeparateFromMain` 400s when `localPath` is inside the main repo or `url` equals the main remote; `_assertDocsRepoUnclaimed` 409s when another project claims the same URL/path (q7: one per project). All covered by tests in `api/routes/projects.docsRepo.test.js` (incl. "keeps the main repo clean" and "writes nothing KainBain into it").
12|- **Single seam**: `resolveKainbainHome(cwd, project)` (`api/project/resolveKainbainHome.js`) maps docs/state resolution onto `docsRepo.localPath` when set, else `cwd`. `resolveDocsPath`, `resolveKainbainDir` and everything derived from them (`resolveTasksDir`, `resolveTaskDocsDir`, `resolveSessionsDir`, `resolveWorktreesDir`, `resolveQuarantineDir`, `resolveProjectConfigPath`, `reportRelPath`) chain through it. `promptCuration.js` was fixed to route through `resolveTaskDocsDir` instead of hand-building `<cwd>/docs/...`. Legacy projects (no `docsRepo`) are byte-identical — proven by `api/docsRepoResolution.test.js`.
13|- **Runners (the core ask)**: `prepareWorkdir` grows `docsRepoUrl`/`docsLocalPath` and prepares a paired docs worktree `<workRoot>/kb-<taskId>-docs` on the SAME `kb/<taskId>` branch from its own mirror (clone mode) or adopted checkout (`runner/project.js`). The pair counts as one `WORKTREE_CAP` slot; `listOrphanWorkdirs` hides the `-docs` twin and eviction/reap treat the pair atomically. The claim payload carries the redacted `docsRepoUrl` (`api/flow/runnerRoutes.js`), so remote runners can clone both. `shouldSyncTaskDocs` skips the primary→worktree docs copy when the docs worktree exists (docs already live there via git); `collectTaskFiles` and `KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS` read from the docs worktree; `applyBackendPrompt` retargets backend-curated docs paths to the runner's docs worktree (docs-home rewrite first, to avoid the `<cwd>-kainbain-docs` prefix trap); `commitAndPush` commits+pushes the docs worktree FIRST and labels failures `docs repo (...)` before any code push (`runner/gitOps.js`). Real-git integration tests cover clone mode, adopt mode, same-URL refusal, docs-first push order, and docs-failure-aborts-code-push (`runner/project.docsRepo.test.js`).
14|- **Auth (q3)**: same login as the main repo (ambient git credentials); stored URL is credential-redacted at write and re-redacted on read/exposure (`normalizeDocsRepoSettings`, `docsRepoUrlFor`, `assertValidDocsRepoForWrite`). Matches the survey answer; no new secret surface.
15|
16|## 2. Did it follow the plan?
17|
18|Mostly yes. Phase 1's "make change easy" seam (`resolveKainbainHome`) landed exactly as designed (D1), the validation scaffolding (D4) is strict-on-write/tolerant-on-read with `INVALID_DOCS_REPO_*` codes like the existing docsDirName pattern, and the runner seam prep (D5) exists (`docsWorkdirFor`, `shouldSyncTaskDocs`). Two documented deviations from the plan/survey, both surfaced in `site-docs/separate-docs-repo.md` as v1 limitations:
19|
20|1. **q4 (existing docs on switch-on)**: survey answer was "Ask me each time"; the implementation leaves old docs in place and only new work goes to the docs repo, with a documented manual move procedure (the plan's ★ recommendation). No per-time prompt exists. Safe and reversible; flagging so the requester can confirm this matches intent.
21|2. **B5 (merge stage)**: docs `kb/*` branches are created/pushed synced but NOT auto-merged at the merge stage in v1 — explicitly documented in the site-docs limitations. Code merge semantics unchanged.
22|
23|## 3. Code standards & best practices
24|
25|- One-function-per-file convention kept: `npm run check:one-function` PASS (860 files).
26|- ESLint on all changed api/frontend files: **0 errors** (only pre-existing warning classes). JSDoc `MARK:` blocks on all new modules; `check:jsdoc-example` and `check-doc-links` pass.
27|- Barrel surface test updated (`api/projectStore.barrel.test.js`) — this was the first CI failure (20261119-145122); now green (60/60 in the new api test files).
28|- Publish gate fixed: `publish.sh` runner gate now lists `runner/project.docsRepo.test.js`, `scripts/run-tests.mjs` includes it, and `tests/publish.test.mjs` regex widened to accept dots in runner test filenames — the second CI failure (20261119-152529); `node --test tests/publish.test.mjs` now 8/8.
29|- No new dependencies; no second git implementation (runner reuses `runGit`/mirror/worktree helpers); no force-push semantics added; recovery/eviction invariants extended to the pair rather than reinvented.
30|
31|## 4. Easy to modify later / tech debt
32|
33|- Compatibility anchor is explicit: absent `docsRepo` = legacy behaviour byte-for-byte, asserted by tests. `branchMode: "synced"` is the only v1 value but the field is stored, so a future "single-branch" mode is additive. One-docs-repo-per-project is enforced with a clear 409 so sharing later is a designed change, not a refactor.
34|- Minor docs gap: `AGENTS-MAP.md` (repo root) line 23 enumerates `api/project/` domains but does not mention the new `docsRepo`/`docsRepoPointer` domains. Not fixable from this docs-only stage; recommend adding one line in a follow-up.
35|- Runner/backend duplication (`resolveRunnerDocsRepoUrl`, `resolveRunnerKainbainHome` mirroring backend) is intentional per the "runner ships standalone" invariant, and documented as such.
36|
37|## 5. Docs updated?
38|
39|- `site-docs/separate-docs-repo.md` — user guide with setup (create/import/settings), how it works, manual move procedure, stealth verification checklist, and v1 limitations. Passes `siteDocs`, `siteDocs.integrity`, `siteDocs.frontendParity`, `siteDocs.deploy`, `agentGuide` tests (55/55).
40|- `CHANGELOG.md` entry added. Task docs (`IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`, `SURVEY.md`) present.
41|
42|## 6. Verification performed in this review (read-only; live app untouched)
43|
44|- New backend tests: 60/60 pass (`project/docsRepo`, `docsRepoPointer`, `assertDocsRepoSeparateFromMain`, `projectStore.barrel`, `docsRepoResolution`, `routes/projects.docsRepo`, `promptCuration.docsDir`).
45|- Related regression suites: 362/362 (`projectStore`, `docsPath`, `kainbainDir`, `work/task*`, `routes/projects*`) and 191/191 (`flow/runnerRoutes`, `promptCuration`).
46|- Full runner gate list from `publish.sh`: 460/460 pass. `tests/publish.test.mjs`: 8/8 pass.
47|- Frontend tests for all changed components: 139/139 pass. ESLint: 0 errors.
48|- UI proof via isolated headless Chromium against a scratch vite dev server on :5299 (serving this branch from source; live :3100 never modified, scratch server stopped afterwards). Screenshots (PNG magic verified):
49|  - `review-create-advanced.png` — New Project dialog, Advanced expanded, "Docs Repository URL (optional)" visible.
50|  - `review-adopt-advanced.png` — Add Existing Project dialog, Advanced expanded, URL + local path fields visible.
51|  - `review-settings-docsrepo.png` — Project Settings → Files & Repos shows "Separate Docs Repository URL (optional)" and "Docs Repository Local Path (optional)".
52|  - Note: the app currently deployed on :3100 runs the older build and does not show the new section — expected, since this branch is not deployed.
53|
54|## Verdict
55|
56|PASS. The feature achieves the stated goal (separate private docs repo, runners get an adjacent checkout with synced `kb/<taskId>` branches, UI option under Advanced on create/import plus settings, main repo stays trace-free with enforced guards), follows the approved plan's seam design, meets the repo's code standards, keeps legacy behaviour byte-identical, and both previous CI failures are fixed and re-verified green. The two deviations (q4 leave-in-place instead of per-time prompt; no automatic docs-branch merge in v1) are documented v1 limitations, not defects.

224|/***
225| * MARK: SETTINGS_SEARCH_INDEX
226| * @description Search entries with their tab name filled in from
227| *   `PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS` (the one place tab names live), so a tab rename
228| *   updates search results instead of leaving a stale copied name behind.
229| *   An entry pointing at an unknown tab keeps a plain fallback name and is
230| *   caught by the agreement test; at runtime the jump handler also ignores
231| *   unknown tabs, so a bad entry can never switch to a blank page.
232| * @example SETTINGS_SEARCH_INDEX.find((e) => e.id === 'git-repo').tabLabel => 'Files & Repos'
233| ***/
234|export const SETTINGS_SEARCH_INDEX = SETTINGS_SEARCH_INDEX_SOURCE_ENTRIES.map((entry) => ({
235|  ...entry,
236|  tabLabel: PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS.find((tab) => tab.id === entry.tab)?.label ?? 'Project Settings',
237|}));
238|
239|/***
240| * MARK: scoreWord
241| * @description Scores one index entry against a single normalized word: 3 for
242| *   a label prefix match, 2 for a label substring, 1 for a keyword
243| *   substring, 0 for no match. Scores rank `searchSettings` so label hits
244| *   lead. A non-array `keywords` field scores 0 instead of throwing.
245| * @example scoreWord({ label: 'Git Repository URL', keywords: ['git'] }, 'git') => 3
246| * @param {Object} entry - One `SETTINGS_SEARCH_INDEX` entry.
247| * @param {string} word - Lowercase query word.
248| * @returns {number} Match score (0 = no match).
249| ***/
250|const scoreWord = (entry, word) => {
251|  const label = String(entry?.label ?? '').toLowerCase();
252|  if (label.startsWith(word)) return 3;
253|  if (label.includes(word)) return 2;
254|  const keywords = Array.isArray(entry?.keywords) ? entry.keywords : [];
255|  if (keywords.some((keyword) => String(keyword).toLowerCase().includes(word))) return 1;
256|  return 0;
257|};
258|
259|/***
260| * MARK: searchSettings
261| * @description Returns index entries matching a query (case-insensitive).
262| *   Multi-word queries match when EVERY word hits (label substring or
263| *   keyword substring), so "centralised docs folder" finds the docs-link
264| *   setting however the words are ordered. Scores sum the per-word best
265| *   hits, best matches first with index order breaking ties. Blank queries
266| *   and non-matches return an empty array.
267| * @example searchSettings('git') => [{ id: 'git-repo', tab: 'files', … }]
268| * @param {string} query - Raw user input.
269| * @returns {Array<Object>} Matching entries, ranked best-first.
270| ***/
271|export const searchSettings = (query) => {
272|  const normalized = String(query ?? '')
273|    .trim()
274|    .toLowerCase();
275|  if (!normalized) return [];
276|  const words = normalized.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
277|  return SETTINGS_SEARCH_INDEX.map((entry, index) => {
278|    let score = 0;
279|    for (const word of words) {
280|      const wordScore = scoreWord(entry, word);
281|      // One missed word disqualifies the entry (AND semantics).
282|      if (wordScore === 0) return null;
283|      score += wordScore;
284|    }
285|    return { entry, score, index };
286|  })
287|    .filter((hit) => hit !== null)
288|    .sort((first, second) => second.score - first.score || first.index - second.index)
289|    .map((hit) => hit.entry);
290|};
291|
292|/***
293| * MARK: findBestMatch
294| * @description Returns the single best index entry for a query (for
295| *   jump-on-Enter), or null when nothing matches.
296| * @example findBestMatch('git') => { id: 'git-repo', tab: 'files', … }
297| * @param {string} query - Raw user input.
298| * @returns {Object|null} The best matching entry, if any.
299| ***/
300|export const findBestMatch = (query) => searchSettings(query)[0] ?? null;

200|	// Per-test (and per-hook) budget. The default 30s is too tight for the

202|	// (project reset + full app ready + fonts) measured 35s under the
203|	// overlapped gate load and failed the Mobile Empty-state visual spec
204|	// before retrying. 60s keeps a genuine hang bounded while absorbing the
205|	// scheduler jitter the old budget could not.
206|	timeout: 60000,
207|	// No retries: a red test fails the gate on the first failure so flakes
208|	// stay visible instead of being absorbed. Use
209|	// `node scripts/repeat-tests.mjs --suite canary` to measure a suspected
210|	// flake's hit rate, then fix the root cause.
211|	retries: 0,
212|	use: {
213|		baseURL,
214|		screenshot: "only-on-failure",
215|	},
216|	// Never reuse a running stack: a server orphaned by a crashed run (or by
217|	// an older config without the scratch env isolation) would silently
218|	// serve every later invocation with stale projects, an old harness, or

220|	// Playwright on clean exit.

224|					command: "node ../api/index.js",

241|					timeout: 120000,
242|					env: {
243|						PORT: apiPort,
244|						PROJECTS_ROOT: scratchProjectsRoot,
245|						NOTES_SPACE_ROOT: scratchNotesRoot,
246|						// Keep the autonomous dispatcher off: the specs create passive
247|						// in_stage fixtures and drive every stage explicitly; without
248|						// this the scheduler completes them mid-test (header note).
249|						KAINBAIN_DISABLE_SCHEDULER: "true",
250|						// Isolate containment state (see scratchCircuitFile): a
251|						// tripped scratch breaker must never reach prod's file.
252|						KAINBAIN_CIRCUIT_STATE_FILE: scratchCircuitFile,
253|						// Isolate the Runner registry (see scratchRunnerStateFile):
254|						// the host's live fleet must never appear in the
255|						// scratch Now Playing bar or runner assertions.
256|						KAINBAIN_RUNNER_STATE_FILE: scratchRunnerStateFile,
257|						KAINBAIN_FLEET_CATALOG_FILE: scratchFleetCatalogFile,
258|						// Run agent stages on the zero-credential mock harness:
259|						// the suite asserts flow/UI behavior, never model
260|						// output, and ambient model defaults rot (a dead
261|						// external default 404ed every agent run, tripped the
262|						// breaker, and 409ed the engine-driven specs).
263|						KAINBAIN_DEFAULT_HARNESS: "mock",
264|						// The specs drive the legacy embedded agent loop end
265|						// to end (execute -> survey/human -> advance). Keep
266|						// the runner-only production default off here: there
267|						// is no live Runner in the scratch stack, so servable
268|						// agent stages would defer forever and never reach
269|						// the stages under test.
270|						KAINBAIN_RUNNER_EXECUTION_ONLY: "false",
271|						// Pin hermetic transport for vibe and muse so model enumeration
272|						// does not attempt host ACP/MSP spawns (mirrors isolatedTestRoots.js).
273|						KAINBAIN_VIBE_ACP: "off",
274|						KAINBAIN_MUSE_MSP: "off",
275|						// The canary suite assumes the seeded sample pipeline
276|						// (Project A with Idea/... stages). Seed it even though
277|						// production default keeps the board empty.
278|						KAINBAIN_SEED_SAMPLE_PROJECTS: "true",

282|						// network). Specs never assert push behavior.
283|						KAINBAIN_GIT_REMOTE_TEMPLATE:
284|							"https://git.example.com/canary/${SLUG}.git",
285|					},
286|				},
287|				{
288|					command: `npm run dev --prefix ../frontend -- --port ${vitePort} --strictPort`,
289|					url: baseURL,

292|					env: {

294|						VITE_WS_URL: apiURL.replace(/^http/, "ws"),
295|					},
296|				},
297|			],
298|	reporter: [["html", { open: "never" }], ["list"]],

## Stage goal for this attempt

Explicit stage directive: *Make sure this task branch is up to date with main
and is without merge conflicts* — plus re-proof of the human correction
"Cant see settings in the Ui" after the latest `origin/main` movement.

## Branch freshness (observed this attempt)

- `git fetch origin` — `origin/main` had moved 11 commits ahead of this
  branch (capacity-refusal re-dispatch backoff, task `3b82f6ae`).
- Merged `origin/main` into the task branch with a plain merge commit
  (`ort` strategy, no conflicts, no manual resolution needed):
  `16 0` (`git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/main`) —
  HEAD is 16 ahead, **0 behind** `origin/main`.
- Merge-base equals `origin/main` (`e85d88a3`), so `HEAD` contains `main`.
- `git merge-tree $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD origin/main` →
  zero `<<<<<<<` conflict markers.
- The merge was purely additive to this branch's surfaces: 30 files,
  +1825/−15 — new `api/flow/capacityRefusal.js`, `resumeBackoff.js`,
  `scanClaimableTasks.js` updates and the `3b82f6ae` task docs. No
  `frontend/` or `runner/` file was touched by the merge, so the docs-repo
  UI and runner pair preservation are byte-identical to the prior stage's
  proof.

No merge conflict exists — the branch is ready for the engine's merge stage.

## Root cause (re-confirmed this attempt)

Two compounding visibility problems, both fixed on this branch and both
present in the fresh build below:

1. **Collapsed, generically named toggles.** On `origin/main`, both Create
   and Adopt dialogs keep the docs-repo option under a collapsed disclosure
   labelled bare "Advanced options" (`useState(false)` — verified with
   `git show origin/main:.../Header.jsx`). A reviewer who never clicks the
   toggle never sees the `Docs Repository URL (optional)` field. On this
   branch both disclosures are **expanded by default** (`useState(true)`)
   and the toggle is explicitly named *"Advanced options: separate docs
   repo"*, so the named option is findable even when collapsed.
2. **Settings buried below the fold.** The full setting lives in Settings →
   Files & Repos (a long scrollable tab); the landing tab (Project Settings)
   now carries a `Separate Docs Repository: On/Off` summary row directly
   under Project Name with a jump button to Files & Repos, and settings
   search (`separate docs repo` / `stealth` / `private`) jumps straight to
   the fields. The dialogs scroll (`max-h-[90vh]`, pinned header + scrolling
   form) so the field and submit button stay reachable on short viewports.

The instance the human checks serves a pre-branch bundle (see stage 8
forensics: live bundle has 0 occurrences of the visibility strings and a
bare `Advanced options` ×2). The setting therefore becomes visible there
only when the engine merges this branch and runs `deploy.sh --prod`
(the backend host differs from this runner, so there is no in-worktree way
to push the new bundle there from here). This stage proves the merged
branch itself carries the fix — fresh tests, fresh bundle, and fresh
live-DOM screenshots from a scratch stack after the merge.

## This attempt's evidence (all observed)

- Frontend tests (via `npm run test --prefix frontend`):
  `Header + ProjectSettings + ProjectBasicsSection + PathsAndReposSection +
  projectSettingsSearch` — **159 passed** (5 files). The Header expanded-by-
  default tests assert the docs-repo field is in the DOM *without* any
  toggle click, and the ProjectSettings tests cover save/clear/409 flows.
- API tests (via `npm test --prefix api`): `routes/projects.docsRepo` —
  **15 passed**; merged-main capacity tests
  (`capacityRefusal` + `resumeBackoff` + `scanClaimableTasks`) — **18 passed**.
- Runner tests (via `node --test runner/project.docsRepo.test.js`):
  **16 passed** (paired-worktree eviction/reap preservation).
- Repo gates: `check:one-function` PASS (885 files, 281 grandfathered);
  `check:binaries` OK; `check:proof-hygiene` OK (only recorded pre-existing
  baseline violations in unrelated task folders).
- Fresh production bundle: `npm run build --prefix frontend` green (4.68s);
  `frontend/dist/assets/index-CmIipZ8T.js` contains
  `Advanced options: separate docs repo` ×2, `Separate Docs Repository` ×4,
  `Configure in Files` ×1, `Docs Repository URL` ×3 (gitignored — deploy
  rebuilds it).
- Live-DOM assertions from the scratch stack below (Playwright, headless
  Chromium 1280×720, all true):
  create toggle `aria-expanded=true` + `Docs Repository URL (optional)`
  visible without a click; adopt URL + local-path fields visible;
  Project-tab summary `Off` + jump button visible in the first viewport;
  Files & Repos URL field visible with the Disabled explainer text;
  `separate docs repo` search lists both docs entries.

## Live screenshots (scratch stack, post-merge — all observed)

Scratch stack: API on `:3399` (`PROJECTS_ROOT=/tmp/kb-7f62-proof/projects`,
scheduler disabled, mock harness, seeded Project A) + vite on `:5299`
(`VITE_API_BASE` wired to `:3399`); both stopped after capture. PNG magic
`8950 4e47…` verified for all five:

- `stage9-proof-1-create-720.png` — Create dialog, Advanced already open,
  `Docs Repository URL (optional)` field + explainer visible.
- `stage9-proof-2-adopt-720.png` — Import dialog, Advanced already open,
  URL field visible, local-path field below (dialog scrolls; DOM-confirmed).
- `stage9-proof-3-project-jump.png` — Settings → Project Settings (landing
  tab): `Separate Docs Repository: Off` row directly under Project Name
  with `Configure in Files & Repos` jump button, first viewport.
- `stage9-proof-4-settings-files-repos-720.png` — Files & Repos:
  *Separate Docs Repository* block (Disabled status + URL + local path).
- `stage9-proof-5-settings-search.png` — typing `separate docs repo` in
  settings search lists `Separate Docs Repositor…` + `Docs Repository
  Local Pa…`, both → Files & Repos.

## Where to find it after merge + deploy

1. Create: Project dropdown → **+ New Project** → *Advanced options:
   separate docs repo* (already open) → `Docs Repository URL (optional)`.
2. Import: Project dropdown → **+ Add Existing Project…** → same Advanced
   section → URL + `Docs Repo Local Path (optional)`. Dialogs scroll if
   the window is short.
3. Existing project: **Settings** tab → **Project Settings** (landing tab)
   → `Separate Docs Repository: On/Off` row directly under Project Name,
   with a jump button; **Files & Repos** → *Separate Docs Repository*
   block (status line + URL + local path). Typing `separate docs repo`
   (or `stealth`) in settings search goes straight to the fields.
   Hard-refresh (`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R`) after deploy to drop the old bundle.
"}

1|# PR Review — Separate docs repo per project (task 7f6220c3)
2|
3|Reviewer stage: PR review. Verdict: **PASS** (details at the bottom).
4|Scope of review: full `git diff main` (62 files, +9453/−99), previous stage reports, and live verification runs. No source files were modified in this stage; only this report and three screenshots under this task's docs folder were added.
5|
6|## 1. Does it achieve the goal?
7|
8|Yes. A project can now keep ALL KainBain information (task docs, plans, reports, and the `.kainbain/` state incl. `project.json`) in a separate private git repo:
9|
10|- **Opt-in config surface**: `docsRepo: { url, localPath?, branchMode: "synced" }` on the project record, accepted by `POST /projects`, `POST /projects/register`, and `PATCH /projects/:id` (`api/routes/projects.js`). In the UI it appears under a collapsed **Advanced options** disclosure on both the New Project and Add Existing Project dialogs (`frontend/src/components/layout/Header.jsx` + new `DocsRepoFields.jsx`), and in Project Settings → Files & Repositories (`PathsAndReposSection.jsx`, `ProjectSettingsForm.jsx`) for enable/disable later. Matches survey q2 (Advanced section) and the task text ("allowed from the default when you import/create").
11|- **Stealth (q5)**: with `docsRepo` set, nothing KainBain-related is written into the main repo — `createProject` skips the `.gitignore` write and the docs symlink (`api/projectStore.js:978,1020`), `ensureDocsLink` returns `external-docs` and never touches `<cwd>/docs` (`api/projectStore.js:1523`), `_migrateDocsLink` is skipped (`api/projectStore.js:2082`), and the pointer map (`docs-repo-pointers.json`) lives engine-globally next to the projects registry, never in the main repo (`api/project/docsRepoPointer.js`). Guards: `assertDocsRepoSeparateFromMain` 400s when `localPath` is inside the main repo or `url` equals the main remote; `_assertDocsRepoUnclaimed` 409s when another project claims the same URL/path (q7: one per project). All covered by tests in `api/routes/projects.docsRepo.test.js` (incl. "keeps the main repo clean" and "writes nothing KainBain into it").
12|- **Single seam**: `resolveKainbainHome(cwd, project)` (`api/project/resolveKainbainHome.js`) maps docs/state resolution onto `docsRepo.localPath` when set, else `cwd`. `resolveDocsPath`, `resolveKainbainDir` and everything derived from them (`resolveTasksDir`, `resolveTaskDocsDir`, `resolveSessionsDir`, `resolveWorktreesDir`, `resolveQuarantineDir`, `resolveProjectConfigPath`, `reportRelPath`) chain through it. `promptCuration.js` was fixed to route through `resolveTaskDocsDir` instead of hand-building `<cwd>/docs/...`. Legacy projects (no `docsRepo`) are byte-identical — proven by `api/docsRepoResolution.test.js`.
13|- **Runners (the core ask)**: `prepareWorkdir` grows `docsRepoUrl`/`docsLocalPath` and prepares a paired docs worktree `<workRoot>/kb-<taskId>-docs` on the SAME `kb/<taskId>` branch from its own mirror (clone mode) or adopted checkout (`runner/project.js`). The pair counts as one `WORKTREE_CAP` slot; `listOrphanWorkdirs` hides the `-docs` twin and eviction/reap treat the pair atomically. The claim payload carries the redacted `docsRepoUrl` (`api/flow/runnerRoutes.js`), so remote runners can clone both. `shouldSyncTaskDocs` skips the primary→worktree docs copy when the docs worktree exists (docs already live there via git); `collectTaskFiles` and `KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS` read from the docs worktree; `applyBackendPrompt` retargets backend-curated docs paths to the runner's docs worktree (docs-home rewrite first, to avoid the `<cwd>-kainbain-docs` prefix trap); `commitAndPush` commits+pushes the docs worktree FIRST and labels failures `docs repo (...)` before any code push (`runner/gitOps.js`). Real-git integration tests cover clone mode, adopt mode, same-URL refusal, docs-first push order, and docs-failure-aborts-code-push (`runner/project.docsRepo.test.js`).
14|- **Auth (q3)**: same login as the main repo (ambient git credentials); stored URL is credential-redacted at write and re-redacted on read/exposure (`normalizeDocsRepoSettings`, `docsRepoUrlFor`, `assertValidDocsRepoForWrite`). Matches the survey answer; no new secret surface.
15|
16|## 2. Did it follow the plan?
17|
18|Mostly yes. Phase 1's "make change easy" seam (`resolveKainbainHome`) landed exactly as designed (D1), the validation scaffolding (D4) is strict-on-write/tolerant-on-read with `INVALID_DOCS_REPO_*` codes like the existing docsDirName pattern, and the runner seam prep (D5) exists (`docsWorkdirFor`, `shouldSyncTaskDocs`). Two documented deviations from the plan/survey, both surfaced in `site-docs/separate-docs-repo.md` as v1 limitations:
19|
20|1. **q4 (existing docs on switch-on)**: survey answer was "Ask me each time"; the implementation leaves old docs in place and only new work goes to the docs repo, with a documented manual move procedure (the plan's ★ recommendation). No per-time prompt exists. Safe and reversible; flagging so the requester can confirm this matches intent.
21|2. **B5 (merge stage)**: docs `kb/*` branches are created/pushed synced but NOT auto-merged at the merge stage in v1 — explicitly documented in the site-docs limitations. Code merge semantics unchanged.
22|
23|## 3. Code standards & best practices
24|
25|- One-function-per-file convention kept: `npm run check:one-function` PASS (860 files).
26|- ESLint on all changed api/frontend files: **0 errors** (only pre-existing warning classes). JSDoc `MARK:` blocks on all new modules; `check:jsdoc-example` and `check-doc-links` pass.
27|- Barrel surface test updated (`api/projectStore.barrel.test.js`) — this was the first CI failure (20261119-145122); now green (60/60 in the new api test files).
28|- Publish gate fixed: `publish.sh` runner gate now lists `runner/project.docsRepo.test.js`, `scripts/run-tests.mjs` includes it, and `tests/publish.test.mjs` regex widened to accept dots in runner test filenames — the second CI failure (20261119-152529); `node --test tests/publish.test.mjs` now 8/8.
29|- No new dependencies; no second git implementation (runner reuses `runGit`/mirror/worktree helpers); no force-push semantics added; recovery/eviction invariants extended to the pair rather than reinvented.
30|
31|## 4. Easy to modify later / tech debt
32|
33|- Compatibility anchor is explicit: absent `docsRepo` = legacy behaviour byte-for-byte, asserted by tests. `branchMode: "synced"` is the only v1 value but the field is stored, so a future "single-branch" mode is additive. One-docs-repo-per-project is enforced with a clear 409 so sharing later is a designed change, not a refactor.
34|- Minor docs gap: `AGENTS-MAP.md` (repo root) line 23 enumerates `api/project/` domains but does not mention the new `docsRepo`/`docsRepoPointer` domains. Not fixable from this docs-only stage; recommend adding one line in a follow-up.
35|- Runner/backend duplication (`resolveRunnerDocsRepoUrl`, `resolveRunnerKainbainHome` mirroring backend) is intentional per the "runner ships standalone" invariant, and documented as such.

52|  - Note: the app currently deployed on :3100 runs the older build and does not show the new section — expected, since this branch is not deployed.
53|
54|## Verdict

1|# Implementation Plan — Separate KainBain Docs Repo per Project
2|
3|Task: `7f6220c3-c536-489c-b952-9858aae9ef21`

5|Companion survey: `./SURVEY.md` (7 questions, currently **unanswered** — see §2)
6|
7|## 1. Goal and non-goals
8|
9|**Goal.** Let a project store its KainBain-specific information in a *separate,
10|private* git repo ("docs repo") instead of inside the main project repo, so that:
11|
12|- large projects are not bloated by `docs/tasks/*` history;
13|- teams with non-KainBain users (or public repos) see no KainBain traces;
14|- a solo user can "stealth use" KainBain at work on a shared repo;
15|- runners check out the docs repo adjacent to the main repo with synced task
16|  branches, keeping operations as close to normal as possible;
17|- the option is offered in UI configuration at project import/create time
18|  (especially on import).
19|
20|**Explicit non-goals for v1** (to be confirmed against survey answers):
21|
22|- Multi-project sharing of one docs repo (survey q7) — v1 is one docs repo per
23|  project; sharing is designed-for but not built.
24|- Automatic migration of existing docs into the new repo (survey q4) — v1
25|  offers "leave old docs, new work goes to the separate repo" plus a documented
26|  manual move; auto-move is a follow-up.
27|- Hiding `kb/<taskId>` working branches from the shared main repo (survey q6)
28|  — v1 keeps code branches in the main repo and separates only docs/state (the
29|  simplest reading of the task); full branch stealth is a named follow-up with
30|  its own design section (§7).
31|
32|## 2. Survey analysis (SURVEY.md) — unanswered, with recommendations
33|
34|The grill survey exists but `answers` is `{}` — nobody has answered yet. The
35|plan below assumes the **recommended** answer for each question (marked ★) and
36|notes where the code must keep the other option open. Before implementation
37|starts, re-run the grill (or get 5 minutes of the requester's time) to confirm;
38|each recommendation is one line to flip.
39|
40|| # | Question | Recommended answer ★ | Why / plan impact |
41||---|----------|----------------------|-------------------|
42|| q1 | What lives in the docs repo? | ★ **Everything KainBain**: task docs (`docs/tasks/*`), plans, reports, **and** KainBain settings/state (`.kainbain/` contents: `project.json`, sessions, worktrees, quarantine) | Stealth requires zero KainBain traces in the main repo (q5). Splitting settings from docs would leave a decision matrix in every resolver. One "KainBain home" location keeps `resolveDocsPath`/`resolveKainbainDir` a single-branch change. If q1 instead resolves to "task docs only", Phase 3 still works: `project.json` stays in main repo and only the docs resolvers move — the seam is the same. |
43|| q2 | Where in the import/create UI? | ★ **Tucked under an 'Advanced' section** on *both* create and import dialogs | Task text says "as an advance option" and "allowed from the default when you import/create". Advanced-collapsed keeps the simple form simple (existing dialogs are minimal: name+remote, path+name) while satisfying "from the default". Also add the same fields to Project Settings (Paths & Repositories) so it can be enabled later. |
44|| q3 | Auth for the (private) docs repo? | ★ **Separate login details just for the docs repo** (stored credential, optional: fall back to same-as-main when blank) | Main repo may be public/shared with no credential while docs repo is private, or the two live on different hosts. Design a `docsRepo` credential slot reusing the existing credential-redaction + `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` patterns; empty = "same as main repo" keeps the simple case one field. Research spike R1 (Phase 0) must confirm the current credential flow first. |
45|| q4 | Existing docs when switching on? | ★ **Leave old docs; only new work goes to the separate repo** (+ documented manual move command) | Auto-move is a data-loss-risky migration (symlink/shadow history — see `ensureDocsLink` incident note). Leave-in-place is safe, reversible, and matches "make change easy then make the change". Auto-move becomes a follow-up stage with its own backup/verify semantics. |
46|| q5 | Main repo completely free of traces? | ★ **Yes — nothing KainBain-related in the main repo** | This is the stated stealth goal ("so I can stealth use kainbain at work"). Consequences: no `.kainbain/` dir, no `docs/tasks/` content, no pointer file, and (v1) `.gitignore` entries must also not be written into the main repo — they move into the docs repo / global config. The task text's "tiny pointer file is fine" alternative is explicitly rejected for v1 because any committed file defeats stealth. |
47|| q6 | Keep `kb/*` working branches out of shared repo too? | ★ **No — branches in the main repo are fine for v1; only docs/state move** (with a designed follow-up) | True branch stealth (code work happening in a fork/private mirror + PRs back) is a fundamentally different execution model (merge/push/review paths all assume `kb/<task>` exists on origin). V1 separates docs; §7 sketches the branch-stealth follow-up. If the requester insists on full stealth for v1, the plan gains ~2 extra phases — escalate before starting. |
48|| q7 | One docs repo per project, or shared? | ★ **One docs repo per project only (v1)** | Sharing needs namespacing (`<docsRepo>/<projectSlug>/tasks/...`), cross-project locking, and quota/permission questions. Single-project keeps every resolver a pure path swap. Design the on-disk layout with a namespaced root anyway (`tasks/` at top level today, reservable for `<slug>/` prefix later) so sharing is additive. |

142|## 4. Target design (v1)
143|
144|### 4.1 Data model — new project fields
145|
146|```text
147|project.docsRepo: {
148|  url: string|null        # credential-REDACTED remote URL, e.g. "https://git.example.com/me/proj-kb.git"
149|  localPath: string|null  # backend-side checkout of the docs repo (absolute).
150|                          # For adopted/local setups: a path the operator gives or
151|                          # KainBain provisions next to cwd. For remote-backed: the
152|                          # backend's own clone/mirror location.
153|  branchMode: "synced"    # v1 fixed: docs repo carries the same kb/<taskId>
154|                          # branches as the code repo (see §4.3). Reserved for
155|                          # future "single-branch" mode.
156|  # auth: decided by research spike R1. Preferred: reuse the host's existing
157|  # credential mechanism per-remote (git credential helper / env), with an
158|  # optional per-project docs credential slot when R1 shows a gap.
159|}
160|```
161|
162|- Absent `docsRepo` (legacy projects, default) = today's behaviour, byte for
163|  byte. This is the compatibility anchor: every new branch is `if
164|  (hasDocsRepo(project)) … else …today…`.
165|- Validation mirrors `assertValidDocsDirNameForWrite`:
166|  `assertValidDocsRepoForWrite` → 400 `INVALID_DOCS_REPO_*` codes; tolerant
167|  `normalizeDocsRepoSettings` for reads.
168|- One docs repo per project enforced (q7): backend refuses a `localPath`/`url`
169|  already claimed by another project (clear 409 message), until sharing is
170|  designed.

172|### 4.2 Backend layout — "KainBain home" split
173|
174|Introduce one concept: **`kainbainHome/projectCwd` split**.
175|
176|- Today: `projectCwd` serves as *both* code home and KainBain home
177|  (`<cwd>/docs/tasks`, `<cwd>/.kainbain/*`).
178|- With `docsRepo`: code home stays `projectCwd`; KainBain home becomes the
179|  docs-repo checkout (`docsRepo.localPath` on the backend).
180|- Implementation: add `resolveKainbainHome(project, projectCwd)` =
181|  `docsRepo.localPath || projectCwd`, then re-point `resolveDocsPath` and
182|  `resolveKainbainDir` at it (they already take `(cwd, project)` — the
183|  signature barely changes; internally `cwd` becomes "kainbain home").
184|  All downstream consumers (`taskDocsFiles`, `taskWorkspace`,
185|  `resolveTaskDocsDir`, `reportRelPath`, …) inherit the move with no edits —
186|  this is the "make change easy" payoff.
187|- `ensureDocsLink` / centralised-docs symlink: when `docsRepo` is set, the
188|  `<cwd>/docs` symlink is **not created** (stealth, q5) and
189|  `centralizedDocs` is ignored for that project (documented precedence:
190|  `docsRepo` > `centralizedDocs:false` > symlink). The docs checkout itself is
191|  a real git repo, not a symlink.
192|- `.gitignore` management: today KainBain writes ignore entries for
193|  `docs/tasks/` + `.kainbain/` into the main repo. With `docsRepo`, nothing is
194|  written into the main repo (q5 ★); equivalent ignores (if still needed) live
195|  in the docs repo. Audit every ignore-writing call site in Phase 1.
196|- `project.json`: per q1 ★, the authoritative copy lives in the docs repo
197|  (`<docsHome>/.kainbain/project.json`… or flattened — decided in Phase 1;
198|  recommend keeping the `.kainbain/` layout identical so resolvers don't fork).
199|  The backend's project *registry* (`projectRegistry.js`) keeps a pointer so
200|  `scanProjects` still finds the project. Main repo keeps zero files.

202|### 4.3 Branching — synced task branches across two repos
203|
204|- The docs repo carries the **same branch names** as the code repo:
205|  `kb/<taskId>` per task, same default branch. "Synced" means: created from
206|  the same base event, checked out/created together at stage pickup
207|  (`ensureTaskBranch` gains a docs-repo twin), and pushed together at handoff.
208|- Merge/review semantics stay code-repo-driven: the Merge stage merges code;
209|  docs branches merge (or fast-forward) alongside so docs history tracks task
210|  history. Exact merge coupling (same commit message? docs-merge part of the
211|  merge stage, or lazy?) is decided in design task D3 (Phase 1) — v1 default:
212|  docs branch is merged/fast-forwarded by the same stage right after the code
213|  merge, failures reported but never blocking the code merge verdict… or
214|  blocking — D3 decides with a written rationale.
215|- Runner workdir layout becomes a pair:
216|  `<workRoot>/kb-<taskId>` (code worktree, as today) +
217|  `<workRoot>/kb-<taskId>-docs` (docs worktree, same branch name), each with
218|  its own mirror (`mirrors/<code-slug>`, `mirrors/<docs-slug>`).
219|  `prepareWorkdir` grows a `docsRepoUrl` option; eviction/recovery/reap logic
220|  treats the pair atomically (evict/reap both, park both).
221|- `syncTaskDocs` becomes a no-op source change: with docsRepo, task docs live
222|  *in* the docs worktree already — the copy step is skipped and
223|  `KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS` points at the docs worktree path. `collectTaskFiles`
224|  reads from the docs worktree. `commitAndPush` commits+pushes **both**
225|  worktrees (docs first or code first — D3 decides; recommend docs-first so a
226|  half-pushed state never shows code without its docs… or code-first — D3
227|  writes the rationale either way).

230|

232|  (live `.git/config` remotes + `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` fail-fast). The docs
233|  remote must authenticate the same way wherever possible (same host ⇒ same
234|  credential helper ⇒ zero new secrets UI).
235|- If R1 finds runners/hosts where ambient auth can't cover a second remote,
236|  add an optional per-project docs credential stored server-side, injected via
237|  `GIT_ASKPASS`/header at clone/fetch time, never persisted into `.git/config`,
238|  never logged (extend `redactCredentials` coverage + a redaction test).
239|- Hard rule: docs-repo credentials must never leak into the main repo, task
240|  docs, logs, or claim payloads. Spike R1 must name the exact mechanism before
241|  Phase 2 starts.

# Implementation Plan — Separate KainBain Docs Repo per Project

Task: `7f6220c3-c536-489c-b952-9858aae9ef21`
Status: planning (no code changed in this stage)
Companion survey: `./SURVEY.md` (7 questions, currently **unanswered** — see §2)

## 1. Goal and non-goals

**Goal.** Let a project store its KainBain-specific information in a *separate,
private* git repo ("docs repo") instead of inside the main project repo, so that:

- large projects are not bloated by `docs/tasks/*` history;
- teams with non-KainBain users (or public repos) see no KainBain traces;
- a solo user can "stealth use" KainBain at work on a shared repo;
- runners check out the docs repo adjacent to the main repo with synced task
  branches, keeping operations as close to normal as possible;
- the option is offered in UI configuration at project import/create time
  (especially on import).

**Explicit non-goals for v1** (to be confirmed against survey answers):

- Multi-project sharing of one docs repo (survey q7) — v1 is one docs repo per
  project; sharing is designed-for but not built.
- Automatic migration of existing docs into the new repo (survey q4) — v1
  offers "leave old docs, new work goes to the separate repo" plus a documented
  manual move; auto-move is a follow-up.
- Hiding `kb/<taskId>` working branches from the shared main repo (survey q6)
  — v1 keeps code branches in the main repo and separates only docs/state (the
  simplest reading of the task); full branch stealth is a named follow-up with
  its own design section (§7).

## 2. Survey analysis (SURVEY.md) — unanswered, with recommendations

The grill survey exists but `answers` is `{}` — nobody has answered yet. The
plan below assumes the **recommended** answer for each question (marked ★) and
notes where the code must keep the other option open. Before implementation
starts, re-run the grill (or get 5 minutes of the requester's time) to confirm;
each recommendation is one line to flip.

| # | Question | Recommended answer ★ | Why / plan impact |
|---|----------|----------------------|-------------------|
| q1 | What lives in the docs repo? | ★ **Everything KainBain**: task docs (`docs/tasks/*`), plans, reports, **and** KainBain settings/state (`.kainbain/` contents: `project.json`, sessions, worktrees, quarantine) | Stealth requires zero KainBain traces in the main repo (q5). Splitting settings from docs would leave a decision matrix in every resolver. One "KainBain home" location keeps `resolveDocsPath`/`resolveKainbainDir` a single-branch change. If q1 instead resolves to "task docs only", Phase 3 still works: `project.json` stays in main repo and only the docs resolvers move — the seam is the same. |
| q2 | Where in the import/create UI? | ★ **Tucked under an 'Advanced' section** on *both* create and import dialogs | Task text says "as an advance option" and "allowed from the default when you import/create". Advanced-collapsed keeps the simple form simple (existing dialogs are minimal: name+remote, path+name) while satisfying "from the default". Also add the same fields to Project Settings (Paths & Repositories) so it can be enabled later. |
| q3 | Auth for the (private) docs repo? | ★ **Separate login details just for the docs repo** (stored credential, optional: fall back to same-as-main when blank) | Main repo may be public/shared with no credential while docs repo is private, or the two live on different hosts. Design a `docsRepo` credential slot reusing the existing credential-redaction + `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` patterns; empty = "same as main repo" keeps the simple case one field. Research spike R1 (Phase 0) must confirm the current credential flow first. |
| q4 | Existing docs when switching on? | ★ **Leave old docs; only new work goes to the separate repo** (+ documented manual move command) | Auto-move is a data-loss-risky migration (symlink/shadow history — see `ensureDocsLink` incident note). Leave-in-place is safe, reversible, and matches "make change easy then make the change". Auto-move becomes a follow-up stage with its own backup/verify semantics. |
| q5 | Main repo completely free of traces? | ★ **Yes — nothing KainBain-related in the main repo** | This is the stated stealth goal ("so I can stealth use kainbain at work"). Consequences: no `.kainbain/` dir, no `docs/tasks/` content, no pointer file, and (v1) `.gitignore` entries must also not be written into the main repo — they move into the docs repo / global config. The task text's "tiny pointer file is fine" alternative is explicitly rejected for v1 because any committed file defeats stealth. |
| q6 | Keep `kb/*` working branches out of shared repo too? | ★ **No — branches in the main repo are fine for v1; only docs/state move** (with a designed follow-up) | True branch stealth (code work happening in a fork/private mirror + PRs back) is a fundamentally different execution model (merge/push/review paths all assume `kb/<task>` exists on origin). V1 separates docs; §7 sketches the branch-stealth follow-up. If the requester insists on full stealth for v1, the plan gains ~2 extra phases — escalate before starting. |
| q7 | One docs repo per project, or shared? | ★ **One docs repo per project only (v1)** | Sharing needs namespacing (`<docsRepo>/<projectSlug>/tasks/...`), cross-project locking, and quota/permission questions. Single-project keeps every resolver a pure path swap. Design the on-disk layout with a namespaced root anyway (`tasks/` at top level today, reservable for `<slug>/` prefix later) so sharing is additive. |

**Action before Phase 1:** confirm q1–q7 with the requester (5-minute grill
re-run). If any answer flips, only the flagged phase changes — the Phase 0/1
seams are answer-independent by design.

# Fix verification — "Cant see settings in the Ui" (stage 3, 2026-11-20)

## Root cause (this attempt)

The setting already existed on all surfaces (Create/Import Advanced expanded
by default, Settings → Files & Repos bordered block, Project-tab summary row,
settings search). The reported invisibility had a concrete defect behind it:
neither the **Create New Project** nor the **Add Existing Project** dialog
capped its height or scrolled. Both were `flex flex-col overflow-hidden` with
no `max-h` and a plain non-scrolling `<form>`. With Advanced expanded by
default, the Create dialog is ~640px tall and the Adopt dialog ~750px: on
everyday shorter viewports (laptop ~700px, smaller windows, mobile) the dialog
is taller than the window and its bottom — exactly the docs-repo field and the
Create/Add Project buttons — is clipped with no way to reach it. The stage-2
proof shots passed only because they used a tall 1440x900 viewport.

## Fix

Followed the repo modal convention (`SystemGuideModal`, `UiPreferencesModal`):
dialog `max-h-[90vh]`, header `shrink-0` (pinned), form
`flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto`. Two files changed:
