# Implementation Plan — Separate KainBain Docs Repo per Project

Task: `7f6220c3-c536-489c-b952-9858aae9ef21`
Status: planning (no code changed in this stage)
Companion survey: `./SURVEY.md` (7 questions, currently **unanswered** — see §2)

## 1. Goal and non-goals

**Goal.** Let a project store its KainBain-specific information in a *separate,
private* git repo ("docs repo") instead of inside the main project repo, so that:

- large projects are not bloated by `docs/tasks/*` history;
- teams with non-KainBain users (or public repos) see no KainBain traces;
- a solo user can "stealth use" KainBain at work on a shared repo;
- runners check out the docs repo adjacent to the main repo with synced task
  branches, keeping operations as close to normal as possible;
- the option is offered in UI configuration at project import/create time
  (especially on import).

**Explicit non-goals for v1** (to be confirmed against survey answers):

- Multi-project sharing of one docs repo (survey q7) — v1 is one docs repo per
  project; sharing is designed-for but not built.
- Automatic migration of existing docs into the new repo (survey q4) — v1
  offers "leave old docs, new work goes to the separate repo" plus a documented
  manual move; auto-move is a follow-up.
- Hiding `kb/<taskId>` working branches from the shared main repo (survey q6)
  — v1 keeps code branches in the main repo and separates only docs/state (the
  simplest reading of the task); full branch stealth is a named follow-up with
  its own design section (§7).

## 2. Survey analysis (SURVEY.md) — unanswered, with recommendations

The grill survey exists but `answers` is `{}` — nobody has answered yet. The
plan below assumes the **recommended** answer for each question (marked ★) and
notes where the code must keep the other option open. Before implementation
starts, re-run the grill (or get 5 minutes of the requester's time) to confirm;
each recommendation is one line to flip.

| # | Question | Recommended answer ★ | Why / plan impact |
|---|----------|----------------------|-------------------|
| q1 | What lives in the docs repo? | ★ **Everything KainBain**: task docs (`docs/tasks/*`), plans, reports, **and** KainBain settings/state (`.kainbain/` contents: `project.json`, sessions, worktrees, quarantine) | Stealth requires zero KainBain traces in the main repo (q5). Splitting settings from docs would leave a decision matrix in every resolver. One "KainBain home" location keeps `resolveDocsPath`/`resolveKainbainDir` a single-branch change. If q1 instead resolves to "task docs only", Phase 3 still works: `project.json` stays in main repo and only the docs resolvers move — the seam is the same. |
| q2 | Where in the import/create UI? | ★ **Tucked under an 'Advanced' section** on *both* create and import dialogs | Task text says "as an advance option" and "allowed from the default when you import/create". Advanced-collapsed keeps the simple form simple (existing dialogs are minimal: name+remote, path+name) while satisfying "from the default". Also add the same fields to Project Settings (Paths & Repositories) so it can be enabled later. |
| q3 | Auth for the (private) docs repo? | ★ **Separate login details just for the docs repo** (stored credential, optional: fall back to same-as-main when blank) | Main repo may be public/shared with no credential while docs repo is private, or the two live on different hosts. Design a `docsRepo` credential slot reusing the existing credential-redaction + `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` patterns; empty = "same as main repo" keeps the simple case one field. Research spike R1 (Phase 0) must confirm the current credential flow first. |
| q4 | Existing docs when switching on? | ★ **Leave old docs; only new work goes to the separate repo** (+ documented manual move command) | Auto-move is a data-loss-risky migration (symlink/shadow history — see `ensureDocsLink` incident note). Leave-in-place is safe, reversible, and matches "make change easy then make the change". Auto-move becomes a follow-up stage with its own backup/verify semantics. |
| q5 | Main repo completely free of traces? | ★ **Yes — nothing KainBain-related in the main repo** | This is the stated stealth goal ("so I can stealth use kainbain at work"). Consequences: no `.kainbain/` dir, no `docs/tasks/` content, no pointer file, and (v1) `.gitignore` entries must also not be written into the main repo — they move into the docs repo / global config. The task text's "tiny pointer file is fine" alternative is explicitly rejected for v1 because any committed file defeats stealth. |
| q6 | Keep `kb/*` working branches out of shared repo too? | ★ **No — branches in the main repo are fine for v1; only docs/state move** (with a designed follow-up) | True branch stealth (code work happening in a fork/private mirror + PRs back) is a fundamentally different execution model (merge/push/review paths all assume `kb/<task>` exists on origin). V1 separates docs; §7 sketches the branch-stealth follow-up. If the requester insists on full stealth for v1, the plan gains ~2 extra phases — escalate before starting. |
| q7 | One docs repo per project, or shared? | ★ **One docs repo per project only (v1)** | Sharing needs namespacing (`<docsRepo>/<projectSlug>/tasks/...`), cross-project locking, and quota/permission questions. Single-project keeps every resolver a pure path swap. Design the on-disk layout with a namespaced root anyway (`tasks/` at top level today, reservable for `<slug>/` prefix later) so sharing is additive. |

**Action before Phase 1:** confirm q1–q7 with the requester (5-minute grill
re-run). If any answer flips, only the flagged phase changes — the Phase 0/1
seams are answer-independent by design.

## 3. Current-state findings (grounded in the repo)

All paths below are relative to the repo root. This is the surface the plan
must move:

### 3.1 Backend — project identity and docs location

- `api/projectStore.js` — `ProjectStore`: filesystem-backed projects. Key
  fields on the project record: `cwd` (main checkout), `notesPath`/`notesDir`,
  `docsDirName` (default `docs`), `centralizedDocs` (default true),
  `kainbainDirName` (default `.kainbain`), `gitUrl`/`repoUrl`, `useBranches`.
  `createProject` / `registerProject` provision; `ensureDocsLink` verifies the
  `<cwd>/<docsDir>/ → notes-space` symlink with careful repair policy.
- `api/docsPath.js` — **the docs seam**: `resolveDocsDirName`,
  `isCentralizedDocsEnabled`, `normalizeDocsSettings`,
  `assertValidDocsDirNameForWrite`, `resolveDocsPath(cwd, project)`,

  `reportRelPath`, `docsTasksIgnorePath`. Every task-docs path flows through
  here. ★ This is where "make change easy" concentrates.
- `api/kainbainDir.js` — **the state seam**: mirrors `docsPath.js` for

  `resolveSessionsDir`, `resolveWorktreesDir`, `resolveQuarantineDir`,
  `kainbainIgnorePath`). Per q1-recommended, both seams move together.
- `api/work/taskDocsFiles.js`, `api/work/taskAssets.js`,
  `api/work/taskWorkspace.js` (`repairDocsLinkAfterSwitch`,
  `resolveTaskCwd`, quarantine/worktree dirs), `api/work/taskBranches.js`

# Fix verification — "Cant see settings in the Ui" (stage 3, 2026-11-20)

## Root cause (this attempt)

The setting already existed on all surfaces (Create/Import Advanced expanded
by default, Settings → Files & Repos bordered block, Project-tab summary row,
settings search). The reported invisibility had a concrete defect behind it:
neither the **Create New Project** nor the **Add Existing Project** dialog
capped its height or scrolled. Both were `flex flex-col overflow-hidden` with
no `max-h` and a plain non-scrolling `<form>`. With Advanced expanded by
default, the Create dialog is ~640px tall and the Adopt dialog ~750px: on
everyday shorter viewports (laptop ~700px, smaller windows, mobile) the dialog
is taller than the window and its bottom — exactly the docs-repo field and the
Create/Add Project buttons — is clipped with no way to reach it. The stage-2
proof shots passed only because they used a tall 1440x900 viewport.

## Fix

Followed the repo modal convention (`SystemGuideModal`, `UiPreferencesModal`):
dialog `max-h-[90vh]`, header `shrink-0` (pinned), form
`flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto`. Two files changed:

- `frontend/src/components/layout/Header.jsx` — both dialogs (Create + Adopt).
- `frontend/src/components/layout/Header.test.jsx` — 2 new scroll-contract
  tests (dialog caps at `max-h-[90vh]`, form scrolls, docs fields present).

## Evidence

- Tests: touched-area 159/159; full frontend suite 4976/4976 (364 files);
  `check:duplicate-identifiers` OK; ESLint 0 errors on both files; frontend

# Implementation Plan — Separate KainBain Docs Repo per Project

Task: `7f6220c3-c536-489c-b952-9858aae9ef21`
Status: planning (no code changed in this stage)
Companion survey: `./SURVEY.md` (7 questions, currently **unanswered** — see §2)

## 1. Goal and non-goals

**Goal.** Let a project store its KainBain-specific information in a *separate,
private* git repo ("docs repo") instead of inside the main project repo, so that:

- large projects are not bloated by `docs/tasks/*` history;
- teams with non-KainBain users (or public repos) see no KainBain traces;
- a solo user can "stealth use" KainBain at work on a shared repo;
- runners check out the docs repo adjacent to the main repo with synced task
  branches, keeping operations as close to normal as possible;
- the option is offered in UI configuration at project import/create time
  (especially on import).

**Explicit non-goals for v1** (to be confirmed against survey answers):

- Multi-project sharing of one docs repo (survey q7) — v1 is one docs repo per
  project; sharing is designed-for but not built.
- Automatic migration of existing docs into the new repo (survey q4) — v1
  offers "leave old docs, new work goes to the separate repo" plus a documented
  manual move; auto-move is a follow-up.
- Hiding `kb/<taskId>` working branches from the shared main repo (survey q6)
  — v1 keeps code branches in the main repo and separates only docs/state (the
  simplest reading of the task); full branch stealth is a named follow-up with
  its own design section (§7).

## 2. Survey analysis (SURVEY.md) — unanswered, with recommendations

The grill survey exists but `answers` is `{}` — nobody has answered yet. The
plan below assumes the **recommended** answer for each question (marked ★) and
notes where the code must keep the other option open. Before implementation
starts, re-run the grill (or get 5 minutes of the requester's time) to confirm;
each recommendation is one line to flip.

| # | Question | Recommended answer ★ | Why / plan impact |
|---|----------|----------------------|-------------------|
| q1 | What lives in the docs repo? | ★ **Everything KainBain**: task docs (`docs/tasks/*`), plans, reports, **and** KainBain settings/state (`.kainbain/` contents: `project.json`, sessions, worktrees, quarantine) | Stealth requires zero KainBain traces in the main repo (q5). Splitting settings from docs would leave a decision matrix in every resolver. One "KainBain home" location keeps `resolveDocsPath`/`resolveKainbainDir` a single-branch change. If q1 instead resolves to "task docs only", Phase 3 still works: `project.json` stays in main repo and only the docs resolvers move — the seam is the same. |
| q2 | Where in the import/create UI? | ★ **Tucked under an 'Advanced' section** on *both* create and import dialogs | Task text says "as an advance option" and "allowed from the default when you import/create". Advanced-collapsed keeps the simple form simple (existing dialogs are minimal: name+remote, path+name) while satisfying "from the default". Also add the same fields to Project Settings (Paths & Repositories) so it can be enabled later. |
| q3 | Auth for the (private) docs repo? | ★ **Separate login details just for the docs repo** (stored credential, optional: fall back to same-as-main when blank) | Main repo may be public/shared with no credential while docs repo is private, or the two live on different hosts. Design a `docsRepo` credential slot reusing the existing credential-redaction + `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` patterns; empty = "same as main repo" keeps the simple case one field. Research spike R1 (Phase 0) must confirm the current credential flow first. |
| q4 | Existing docs when switching on? | ★ **Leave old docs; only new work goes to the separate repo** (+ documented manual move command) | Auto-move is a data-loss-risky migration (symlink/shadow history — see `ensureDocsLink` incident note). Leave-in-place is safe, reversible, and matches "make change easy then make the change". Auto-move becomes a follow-up stage with its own backup/verify semantics. |
| q5 | Main repo completely free of traces? | ★ **Yes — nothing KainBain-related in the main repo** | This is the stated stealth goal ("so I can stealth use kainbain at work"). Consequences: no `.kainbain/` dir, no `docs/tasks/` content, no pointer file, and (v1) `.gitignore` entries must also not be written into the main repo — they move into the docs repo / global config. The task text's "tiny pointer file is fine" alternative is explicitly rejected for v1 because any committed file defeats stealth. |
| q6 | Keep `kb/*` working branches out of shared repo too? | ★ **No — branches in the main repo are fine for v1; only docs/state move** (with a designed follow-up) | True branch stealth (code work happening in a fork/private mirror + PRs back) is a fundamentally different execution model (merge/push/review paths all assume `kb/<task>` exists on origin). V1 separates docs; §7 sketches the branch-stealth follow-up. If the requester insists on full stealth for v1, the plan gains ~2 extra phases — escalate before starting. |
| q7 | One docs repo per project, or shared? | ★ **One docs repo per project only (v1)** | Sharing needs namespacing (`<docsRepo>/<projectSlug>/tasks/...`), cross-project locking, and quota/permission questions. Single-project keeps every resolver a pure path swap. Design the on-disk layout with a namespaced root anyway (`tasks/` at top level today, reservable for `<slug>/` prefix later) so sharing is additive. |

# Implementation Plan — Separate KainBain Docs Repo per Project

Task: `7f6220c3-c536-489c-b952-9858aae9ef21`
Status: planning (no code changed in this stage)
Companion survey: `./SURVEY.md` (7 questions, currently **unanswered** — see §2)

## 1. Goal and non-goals

**Goal.** Let a project store its KainBain-specific information in a *separate,
private* git repo ("docs repo") instead of inside the main project repo, so that:

- large projects are not bloated by `docs/tasks/*` history;
- teams with non-KainBain users (or public repos) see no KainBain traces;
- a solo user can "stealth use" KainBain at work on a shared repo;
- runners check out the docs repo adjacent to the main repo with synced task
  branches, keeping operations as close to normal as possible;
- the option is offered in UI configuration at project import/create time
  (especially on import).

**Explicit non-goals for v1** (to be confirmed against survey answers):

- Multi-project sharing of one docs repo (survey q7) — v1 is one docs repo per
  project; sharing is designed-for but not built.
- Automatic migration of existing docs into the new repo (survey q4) — v1
  offers "leave old docs, new work goes to the separate repo" plus a documented
  manual move; auto-move is a follow-up.
- Hiding `kb/<taskId>` working branches from the shared main repo (survey q6)
  — v1 keeps code branches in the main repo and separates only docs/state (the
  simplest reading of the task); full branch stealth is a named follow-up with
  its own design section (§7).

## 2. Survey analysis (SURVEY.md) — unanswered, with recommendations

The grill survey exists but `answers` is `{}` — nobody has answered yet. The
plan below assumes the **recommended** answer for each question (marked ★) and
notes where the code must keep the other option open. Before implementation
starts, re-run the grill (or get 5 minutes of the requester's time) to confirm;
each recommendation is one line to flip.

| # | Question | Recommended answer ★ | Why / plan impact |
|---|----------|----------------------|-------------------|
| q1 | What lives in the docs repo? | ★ **Everything KainBain**: task docs (`docs/tasks/*`), plans, reports, **and** KainBain settings/state (`.kainbain/` contents: `project.json`, sessions, worktrees, quarantine) | Stealth requires zero KainBain traces in the main repo (q5). Splitting settings from docs would leave a decision matrix in every resolver. One "KainBain home" location keeps `resolveDocsPath`/`resolveKainbainDir` a single-branch change. If q1 instead resolves to "task docs only", Phase 3 still works: `project.json` stays in main repo and only the docs resolvers move — the seam is the same. |
| q2 | Where in the import/create UI? | ★ **Tucked under an 'Advanced' section** on *both* create and import dialogs | Task text says "as an advance option" and "allowed from the default when you import/create". Advanced-collapsed keeps the simple form simple (existing dialogs are minimal: name+remote, path+name) while satisfying "from the default". Also add the same fields to Project Settings (Paths & Repositories) so it can be enabled later. |
| q3 | Auth for the (private) docs repo? | ★ **Separate login details just for the docs repo** (stored credential, optional: fall back to same-as-main when blank) | Main repo may be public/shared with no credential while docs repo is private, or the two live on different hosts. Design a `docsRepo` credential slot reusing the existing credential-redaction + `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` patterns; empty = "same as main repo" keeps the simple case one field. Research spike R1 (Phase 0) must confirm the current credential flow first. |
| q4 | Existing docs when switching on? | ★ **Leave old docs; only new work goes to the separate repo** (+ documented manual move command) | Auto-move is a data-loss-risky migration (symlink/shadow history — see `ensureDocsLink` incident note). Leave-in-place is safe, reversible, and matches "make change easy then make the change". Auto-move becomes a follow-up stage with its own backup/verify semantics. |
| q5 | Main repo completely free of traces? | ★ **Yes — nothing KainBain-related in the main repo** | This is the stated stealth goal ("so I can stealth use kainbain at work"). Consequences: no `.kainbain/` dir, no `docs/tasks/` content, no pointer file, and (v1) `.gitignore` entries must also not be written into the main repo — they move into the docs repo / global config. The task text's "tiny pointer file is fine" alternative is explicitly rejected for v1 because any committed file defeats stealth. |
| q6 | Keep `kb/*` working branches out of shared repo too? | ★ **No — branches in the main repo are fine for v1; only docs/state move** (with a designed follow-up) | True branch stealth (code work happening in a fork/private mirror + PRs back) is a fundamentally different execution model (merge/push/review paths all assume `kb/<task>` exists on origin). V1 separates docs; §7 sketches the branch-stealth follow-up. If the requester insists on full stealth for v1, the plan gains ~2 extra phases — escalate before starting. |
| q7 | One docs repo per project, or shared? | ★ **One docs repo per project only (v1)** | Sharing needs namespacing (`<docsRepo>/<projectSlug>/tasks/...`), cross-project locking, and quota/permission questions. Single-project keeps every resolver a pure path swap. Design the on-disk layout with a namespaced root anyway (`tasks/` at top level today, reservable for `<slug>/` prefix later) so sharing is additive. |

re-run). If any answer flips, only the flagged phase changes — the Phase 0/1

# Fix verification — "Cant see settings in the Ui" (stage 9, 2026-11-24)

## Stage goal for this attempt

Explicit stage directive: *Make sure this task branch is up to date with main
and is without merge conflicts* — plus re-proof of the human correction
"Cant see settings in the Ui" after the latest `origin/main` movement.

## Branch freshness (observed this attempt)

- `git fetch origin` — `origin/main` had moved 11 commits ahead of this
  branch (capacity-refusal re-dispatch backoff, task `3b82f6ae`).
- Merged `origin/main` into the task branch with a plain merge commit
  (`ort` strategy, no conflicts, no manual resolution needed):
  `16 0` (`git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/main`) —
  HEAD is 16 ahead, **0 behind** `origin/main`.
- Merge-base equals `origin/main` (`e85d88a3`), so `HEAD` contains `main`.
- `git merge-tree $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD origin/main` →
  zero `<<<<<<<` conflict markers.
- The merge was purely additive to this branch's surfaces: 30 files,
  +1825/−15 — new `api/flow/capacityRefusal.js`, `resumeBackoff.js`,
  `scanClaimableTasks.js` updates and the `3b82f6ae` task docs. No
  `frontend/` or `runner/` file was touched by the merge, so the docs-repo
  UI and runner pair preservation are byte-identical to the prior stage's
  proof.

No merge conflict exists — the branch is ready for the engine's merge stage.

## Root cause (re-confirmed this attempt)

Two compounding visibility problems, both fixed on this branch and both
present in the fresh build below:

1. **Collapsed, generically named toggles.** On `origin/main`, both Create
   and Adopt dialogs keep the docs-repo option under a collapsed disclosure
   labelled bare "Advanced options" (`useState(false)` — verified with
   `git show origin/main:.../Header.jsx`). A reviewer who never clicks the
   toggle never sees the `Docs Repository URL (optional)` field. On this
   branch both disclosures are **expanded by default** (`useState(true)`)
   and the toggle is explicitly named *"Advanced options: separate docs
   repo"*, so the named option is findable even when collapsed.
2. **Settings buried below the fold.** The full setting lives in Settings →
   Files & Repos (a long scrollable tab); the landing tab (Project Settings)
   now carries a `Separate Docs Repository: On/Off` summary row directly
   under Project Name with a jump button to Files & Repos, and settings
   search (`separate docs repo` / `stealth` / `private`) jumps straight to
   the fields. The dialogs scroll (`max-h-[90vh]`, pinned header + scrolling
   form) so the field and submit button stay reachable on short viewports.

The instance the human checks serves a pre-branch bundle (see stage 8
forensics: live bundle has 0 occurrences of the visibility strings and a
bare `Advanced options` ×2). The setting therefore becomes visible there
only when the engine merges this branch and runs `deploy.sh --prod`
(the backend host differs from this runner, so there is no in-worktree way
to push the new bundle there from here). This stage proves the merged
branch itself carries the fix — fresh tests, fresh bundle, and fresh
live-DOM screenshots from a scratch stack after the merge.

  `Header + ProjectSettings + ProjectBasicsSection + PathsAndReposSection +
  projectSettingsSearch` — **159 passed** (5 files). The Header expanded-by-
  default tests assert the docs-repo field is in the DOM *without* any
  toggle click, and the ProjectSettings tests cover save/clear/409 flows.
- API tests (via `npm test --prefix api`): `routes/projects.docsRepo` —
  **15 passed**; merged-main capacity tests
  (`capacityRefusal` + `resumeBackoff` + `scanClaimableTasks`) — **18 passed**.
- Runner tests (via `node --test runner/project.docsRepo.test.js`):
  **16 passed** (paired-worktree eviction/reap preservation).
- Repo gates: `check:one-function` PASS (885 files, 281 grandfathered);
  `check:binaries` OK; `check:proof-hygiene` OK (only recorded pre-existing
  baseline violations in unrelated task folders).
- Fresh production bundle: `npm run build --prefix frontend` green (4.68s);
  `frontend/dist/assets/index-CmIipZ8T.js` contains
  `Advanced options: separate docs repo` ×2, `Separate Docs Repository` ×4,
  `Configure in Files` ×1, `Docs Repository URL` ×3 (gitignored — deploy
  rebuilds it).
- Live-DOM assertions from the scratch stack below (Playwright, headless
  Chromium 1280×720, all true):
  create toggle `aria-expanded=true` + `Docs Repository URL (optional)`
  visible without a click; adopt URL + local-path fields visible;
  Project-tab summary `Off` + jump button visible in the first viewport;
  Files & Repos URL field visible with the Disabled explainer text;
  `separate docs repo` search lists both docs entries.

## Live screenshots (scratch stack, post-merge — all observed)

Scratch stack: API on `:3399` (`PROJECTS_ROOT=/tmp/kb-7f62-proof/projects`,
scheduler disabled, mock harness, seeded Project A) + vite on `:5299`
(`VITE_API_BASE` wired to `:3399`); both stopped after capture. PNG magic
`8950 4e47…` verified for all five:

- `stage9-proof-1-create-720.png` — Create dialog, Advanced already open,
  `Docs Repository URL (optional)` field + explainer visible.
- `stage9-proof-2-adopt-720.png` — Import dialog, Advanced already open,
  URL field visible, local-path field below (dialog scrolls; DOM-confirmed).
- `stage9-proof-3-project-jump.png` — Settings → Project Settings (landing
  tab): `Separate Docs Repository: Off` row directly under Project Name
  with `Configure in Files & Repos` jump button, first viewport.
- `stage9-proof-4-settings-files-repos-720.png` — Files & Repos:
  *Separate Docs Repository* block (Disabled status + URL + local path).
- `stage9-proof-5-settings-search.png` — typing `separate docs repo` in
  settings search lists `Separate Docs Repositor…` + `Docs Repository
  Local Pa…`, both → Files & Repos.

## Where to find it after merge + deploy

1. Create: Project dropdown → **+ New Project** → *Advanced options:
   separate docs repo* (already open) → `Docs Repository URL (optional)`.
2. Import: Project dropdown → **+ Add Existing Project…** → same Advanced
   section → URL + `Docs Repo Local Path (optional)`. Dialogs scroll if
   the window is short.
3. Existing project: **Settings** tab → **Project Settings** (landing tab)
   → `Separate Docs Repository: On/Off` row directly under Project Name,
   with a jump button; **Files & Repos** → *Separate Docs Repository*
   block (status line + URL + local path). Typing `separate docs repo`
   (or `stealth`) in settings search goes straight to the fields.
   Hard-refresh (`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R`) after deploy to drop the old bundle.

/***
 * MARK: System settings tabs
 * @description Single source of truth for the System Settings section tabs:
 *   id, label, and whether the settings footer's Reset control applies. The
 *   Notifications and UI panels persist immediately through their own
 *   controls (each with its own reset), so the footer Reset — which only
 *   restores the settings draft (+ Storage remount) — would be a misleading
 *   no-op there and is hidden. Every consumer (the SystemSettingsPage screen,
 *   SystemSettingsContent, unit tests, and the canary tab-bar suite) derives
 *   from this list so a new tab can never drift the expectations again.
 * @example SETTINGS_TABS.find((t) => t.id === 'access') => { id: 'access', label: 'Access', showFooterReset: false }
 ***/

export const SETTINGS_TABS = [
  { id: 'runners', label: 'Runners', showFooterReset: true },
  { id: 'models', label: 'Models', showFooterReset: true },
  { id: 'engine', label: 'Engine', showFooterReset: true },
  { id: 'storage', label: 'Storage', showFooterReset: true },
  { id: 'notifications', label: 'Notifications', showFooterReset: false },
  { id: 'prompt-layout', label: 'Prompt Layout', showFooterReset: false },
  { id: 'images', label: 'Images', showFooterReset: false },
  { id: 'access', label: 'Access', showFooterReset: false },
  { id: 'ui', label: 'UI', showFooterReset: false },
  { id: 'about', label: 'About', showFooterReset: false },
];

/***
 * MARK: SETTINGS_TAB_LABELS
 * @description Ordered tab labels derived from SETTINGS_TABS (render order).
 * @example SETTINGS_TAB_LABELS => ['Runners', 'Models', 'Engine', 'Storage', 'Notifications', 'Prompt Layout', 'Images', 'Access', 'UI', 'About']
 ***/
export const SETTINGS_TAB_LABELS = SETTINGS_TABS.map((tab) => tab.label);

/***
 * MARK: isFooterResetVisible
 * @description Whether the settings footer Reset applies to a section id.
 *   Unknown ids fail open (true) so a future tab without metadata keeps the
 *   legacy behaviour instead of silently losing its reset.
 * @example isFooterResetVisible('ui') => false
 * @param {string} sectionId - Active section id.
 * @returns {boolean} True when the footer Reset should render.
 ***/
export function isFooterResetVisible(sectionId) {
  if (typeof sectionId !== 'string' || !sectionId) return true;
  const tab = SETTINGS_TABS.find((entry) => entry.id === sectionId);
  if (!tab) return true;
  return tab.showFooterReset !== false;
}

/***
 * MARK: PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS
 * @description Single source of truth for the Project Settings tab bar: every
 *   tab's section id, button label + icon, tab-title heading, and whether the
 *   tab shares the one mounted `ProjectSettingsForm` (edits survive switches
 *   between form tabs; workflows/skills render their own panels). Adding a
 *   tab means adding one entry here — the buttons, the `h2` titles, and the
 *   section allowlists below all derive from this list so they cannot drift.
 *   App-wide UI & Workspace customization is NOT one of them — it lives in
 *   System Settings (SystemSettingsPage, `/system-settings`); per-project
 *   visual branding stays here as the accent-color picker inside the form.
 * @example PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS.map((tab) => tab.id) => ['project', 'aliases', 'files-repos', 'addresses', 'workflows', 'skills']
 ***/
export const PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS = [
  {
    id: 'project',
    label: 'Project Settings',
    buttonIcon: '📂',
    heading: 'Project Configuration',
    headingIcon: '⚙️',
    sharesProjectForm: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'aliases',
    label: 'Aliases',
    buttonIcon: '🏷️',
    heading: 'Model Aliases',
    headingIcon: '🏷️',
    sharesProjectForm: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'files-repos',
    label: 'Files & Repos',
    buttonIcon: '📁',
    heading: 'Files & Repositories',
    headingIcon: '📁',
    sharesProjectForm: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'addresses',
    label: 'Addresses',
    buttonIcon: '🌐',
    heading: 'Application Links & Health',
    headingIcon: '🌐',
    sharesProjectForm: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'workflows',
    label: 'Named Workflows',
    buttonIcon: '🔀',
    heading: null,
    headingIcon: null,
    sharesProjectForm: false,
  },
  {
    id: 'skills',
    label: 'Skills',
    buttonIcon: '🧩',
    heading: null,
    headingIcon: null,
    sharesProjectForm: false,
  },
];

/***
 * MARK: PROJECT_SETTINGS_SECTIONS
 * @description Allowlisted sub-sections of the Project Settings page, derived
 *   from `PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS` so the allowlist and the tab bar agree.
 * @example PROJECT_SETTINGS_SECTIONS.includes('aliases') => true
 ***/
export const PROJECT_SETTINGS_SECTIONS = PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS.map((tab) => tab.id);

/***
 * MARK: PROJECT_FORM_SECTIONS
 * @description The project-related tabs share one mounted `ProjectSettingsForm`
 *   (edits survive tab switches); workflows/skills render their own panels.
 *   Derived from `PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS` so a new form tab needs no second edit.
 * @example PROJECT_FORM_SECTIONS.includes('files') => true
 ***/
export const PROJECT_FORM_SECTIONS = PROJECT_SETTINGS_TABS.filter(
  (tab) => tab.sharesProjectForm,
).map((tab) => tab.id);

## Stage goal for this attempt

and is without merge conflicts* — plus re-proof of the human correction
"Cant see settings in the Ui" against current source.

## Branch freshness (observed this attempt)

- `git fetch origin` — no new commits on `origin/main`.
- Merge-base `e85d88a3` == `origin/main` (`e85d88a3`), so HEAD contains main:

  `<<<<<<<` conflict markers.

engine's merge stage.

## Root cause (re-confirmed in source this attempt)

The docs-repo setting exists on this branch on all four surfaces but is
absent — or hidden — on `origin/main` and therefore on any deployment built
from main:

1. **Collapsed, generically named toggles.** On `origin/main`, both Create
   and Adopt dialogs keep the docs-repo option under a collapsed disclosure
   labelled bare "Advanced options" (`Header.jsx:312,320` — `useState(false)`,
   verified with `git show origin/main:.../Header.jsx`). A reviewer who never
   clicks the toggle never sees the `Docs Repository URL (optional)` field.
   On this branch both disclosures are **expanded by default**
   (`Header.jsx:316,327` — `useState(true)`) and the toggle is explicitly
   named *"Advanced options: separate docs repo"* (`Header.jsx:849,997`), so
   the named option is findable even when collapsed. The dialogs also scroll
   (`Header.jsx:764,895` — `max-h-[90vh]`, pinned header + scrolling form)
   so the field and submit button stay reachable on short viewports.
2. **Settings buried below the fold.** On `origin/main`, the full setting is
   a plain unbordered "Separate Docs Repository URL (optional)" label deep in
   Files & Repos with no status line, the Project landing tab has **no**
   summary row (`git show origin/main:.../ProjectBasicsSection.jsx` — 0
   matches for "Separate Docs"), and the settings search has **no** docs-repo
   entries (0 matches for "docs-repo"). On this branch Settings → Files &
   Repos carries a bordered *📚 Separate Docs Repository* block (heading +
   Enabled/Disabled status + URL + local-path fields,
   `PathsAndReposSection.jsx:204`), the landing Project tab carries a
   `Separate Docs Repository: On/Off` summary row directly under Project Name
   with a jump button (`ProjectBasicsSection.jsx:119,142`), and settings
   search covers `separate/docs/repo/private/stealth/remote`
   (`projectSettingsSearch.js:174,181`).

No further source change was needed: the defect is deployment age, not code.
The setting becomes visible wherever this branch is merged and `deploy.sh
--prod` rebuilds the frontend (a hard refresh `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R` drops the
old cached bundle). This stage proves the current branch carries the fix —
fresh tests, fresh bundle, and fresh live-DOM screenshots from a real scratch
API + vite stack on this branch.

  projectSettingsSearch` — **218 passed** (11 files; the pattern also matched

  `check:binaries` OK; `check:proof-hygiene` OK (only recorded pre-existing

  ×2, `Docs Repository Local Path` ×2, `Separate Docs Repository:` ×1,

  lands on Files & Repos fields", and "search lists both docs entries".

## Live screenshots (scratch stack, this branch — all observed)

Scratch stack: real API on `:3399` (`PROJECTS_ROOT=/tmp/kb-7f62-stage10/
projects`, scheduler disabled, seeded Seed Project with no `docsRepo`) +
vite dev on `:5299` (`VITE_API_BASE` wired to `:3399`); both stopped after
capture (ports verified free). PNG magic `8950 4e47…` + `file` → `PNG image
data, 1280 x 720` verified for all five:

- `stage10-proof-1-create-720.png` — Create dialog, Advanced already open,
  `Docs Repository URL (optional)` field + explainer visible at y=455.
- `stage10-proof-2-adopt-720.png` — Import dialog, Advanced already open,
  URL + local-path fields visible by default.
- `stage10-proof-3-project-jump.png` — Settings → Project Settings (landing

  with `Configure in Files & Repos` jump button at y=439, first viewport.
- `stage10-proof-4-settings-files-repos-720.png` — Files & Repos:
  *Separate Docs Repository* block (Disabled status + URL + local path).
- `stage10-proof-5-settings-search.png` — typing `separate docs repo` in
  settings search lists `Separate Docs Repository URL` + `Docs Repository

## Where to find it after merge + deploy

1. Create: Project dropdown → **+ New Project** → *Advanced options:
